Languages: Fluency in English is required; fluency in Spanish or Portuguese is required for this role to support our LATAM customer base.

Minimum 5 years working experience in a system architect, solution engineering, or technical architect role; OR over 4 years experience in an SME/SMB or tech startup operations, consulting, implementation management, pre-sales, or solution engineering role.

Ability to understand business & IT department requirements, translating those business needs into a compelling solution, and presenting your recommendations to executive, technical, and business audiences.

Deep knowledge of enterprise software applications and their delivery, including several of the following:

Coding experience and a willingness to work with code (Apex, Node, Go, R, Java or C#, JavaScript, Python, Ruby, etc.)

Database and data management fundamentals

Web and mobile application development and architecture

Application lifecycle management

Integration principles and tools

Enterprise data management tools and methods

Process orchestration

Principles of network, application, and information security

Good understanding of the architectural principles of cloud-based platforms including SaaS, PaaS, multi-tenancy, multi-tiered infrastructure, etc.

Strong oral, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication and relationship skills.

Strategic thinker, thought leadership, and comfort communicating with executive audiences.

Excellent time management skills and the ability to support multiple, concurrent projects.

Lifelong learner, inquisitive, practical, and passionate about technology and sharing knowledge.

Willing and able to travel occasionally.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or other STEM degrees (or equivalent work experience).

Experience in roles that required working hands-on to build, implement, administer, or maintain enterprise software (e.g., software engineer, system architect, implementation architect, integration architect, or similar).

Understanding of risk mitigation, compliance, and security.

Experience with design thinking, persona-based discovery, or other innovation techniques.

You will work side-by-side with Account Executives and Product teams to ensure customers realize the full value of the platform by designing scalable, secure solutions that integrate D360 into complex enterprise ecosystems—including hyperscalers, data lakes, and governance frameworks.

Lead pre-sales technical design by analyzing customer needs and recommending solutions aligned with Agentforce capabilities and integration with external agent frameworks.

Support Early Adoption - Occasionally assist in proof-of-value engagements post-sale by tuning agents and guiding customers toward self-sufficient enablement.

Excellent Communication - Strong presentation skills; adept at explaining complex ideas and guiding stakeholders toward impactful solutions.

Enable the Customer Center of Excellence (CoE): Lead the customer in building and nurturing their internal CoE. Train "Agent Champions" and empower the customer to independently iterate, govern, and scale their AI footprint.

Role Description

The D360 Technical Architect plays a pivotal role in developing innovative solutions for our customers across a variety of industries. Our D360 customers are only as successful as the value they derive from the platform. You will play a key role in ensuring D360 is the right fit, help them prioritize the most valuable D360 use cases, and provide technical architecture best practices to drive product adoption.

You will collaborate with the broader global D360 team to develop use cases, demos, sales plays, and technical thought leadership. You will also have a meaningful role in driving our Product Roadmap forward and serve as a key advisor to the Product organization sharing innovative ideas and feedback from customers

Key Responsibilities

Solve Business Problems - Analyze complex business problems by conducting research and assessments to define the problem, generate innovative ideas, see opportunities, and recommend actionable solutions.

Drive Innovation & Customer Adoption - Bring structure to the client's decision-making process by communicating and evaluating solution options, and facilitating agreement among key stakeholders that helps customers prioritize high-value solutions, driving business impact.

Connect the “Art of the Possible” - Assist Solutions Engineers with delivering software demonstrations, rapid prototyping, and storytelling to show how connected experiences come to life with the Salesforce D360 & Salesforce CRM.

Cross Platform Collaboration - You will use your understanding of customers’ use cases across industries and multiple technology landscapes (CRM, Modern Data Stack, Analytics & BI, CRM and AI) to develop solutions across the Salesforce's technology stack.

Provide Technical Domain Expertise - Answer in-depth D360 questions related to data governance, security, and other technical capabilities. Create architectural diagrams, write technical thought-leadership pieces (blogs, whitepapers, etc.), documentation, enablement materials to help us stay ahead of industry trends and help our customer’s implement best practices with D360.

Key Requirements

Experience in solutions engineering/solutions architecture/technical consulting, ideally in the B2B SaaS space, particularly cloud data platforms

Strong verbal and presentation abilities, capable of effectively communicating ideas to clients and prospective clients at all levels of an organization

Understanding & ability to articulate the relationship between Data and Customer Relationship Management, aka the Customer360

Demonstrable ability to shift clients to alternative solutions when initial solutions are not a fit, with examples to support this. Demonstrable experience leading strategy and digital roadmap projects in a complex business environment

Experience with Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, Cloud Technology, Business Intelligence and CRM products

Experience in programming languages such as Javascript, Python, and SQL or Salesforce App Development with LWCs, Apex, Flow etc

Preferred Requirements

Implementation or Sales Experience in Salesforce D360 and Agentforce

Hands on Experience on Salesforce CRM technology like Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud or any Industry Clouds

Broad range of experience in large-scale database and data warehousing technology, like Snowflake or Databricks, as well as ETL processes, analytics and cloud technologies, Data Engineering, Data Science

Hands on Experience in AI/ML solutions like Einstein, Sagemaker, and Vertex. Solid Understanding of Generative AI.

Hands on Experience designing data solutions on cloud platforms like Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.

Hands-on expertise with analytics tools like Tableau, PowerBI, Looker, etc

Familiarity with data activation or "reverse ETL" platforms in the context of Composable Data Platforms (CDP) and integrating various marketing technologies and data tools into a cohesive system.

Experience will be evaluated based on alignment to the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer work, etc.)

Support documentation management, file organisation, and confidential information handling.

As an AI and Data Technical Architect, you will act as a senior, hands-on technical leader and trusted advisor to our customers. You will be responsible for designing, validating, and operationalizing enterprise-grade data and AI architectures centered on Salesforce D360 and the Agentforce platform. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, platform architecture, and applied AI, requiring you to guide customer Chief Data Officers and Enterprise Architects through emerging AI solutions. Lead pre-sales technical design by analyzing customer needs and recommending solutions aligned with Agentforce capabilities and integration with external agent frameworks.

Shape best practices around generative AI, agent interoperability, prompt engineering, Data Cloud, and cross-platform integrations.

Collaborate with AEs and SEs to build hands-on prototypes and demos using Agentforce and integrated external agents.

Develop thought leadership content—demo templates, whitepapers, enablement sessions—focused on agent lifecycle, integration strategy, and technical effectiveness.

Act as a central technical knowledge resource, proactively addressing internal technical inquiries, facilitating deep technical enablement, and documenting best practices to empower specialist teams across the organization.
 

If you are naturally curious about AI and Data, love diving into new technologies, and enjoy educating others while crafting solutions that deliver real business impact, we want to talk to you!
 

Responsibilities

Understand Agent Interoperability - Map and integrate external agents from hyperscalers (e.g. Copilot, Gemini) into Agentforce via open standards (MCP, A2A); design how these systems collaborate.

Enable Conversational & Background Agents - Use Agentforce Studio and Agent Builder to configure chat and background agents; integrate with external channels including voice via hyperscaler APIs.

Drive Prompt Engineering & Lifecycle Strategy - Lead prompt design, testing, monitoring, and iteration; define agent lifecycle best practices from development through refinement.

Build Hands-On Demos & Prototypes - Co-create quick prototypes (<2 weeks) with AEs demonstrating integration between Agentforce and external agents or services.

Lead Pre-Sales Workshops - Facilitate whiteboarding, deep-dive sessions, and quick enablement for customers and internal teams.

Advise on Data & Integration - Integrate Data Cloud (D360), CRM, MuleSoft APIs, and external agent endpoints ensuring cohesive architectures that align with compliance and governance policies.

Support Early Adoption - Occasionally assist in proof-of-value engagements post-sale by tuning agents and guiding customers toward self-sufficient enablement.

Own Technical Architecture Decisions - Oversee data modeling, identity resolution, real-time vs. batch patterns, data graph design, and activation strategies within D360.

Own Technical Enablement - Create and manage accessible technical documentation, knowledge bases, and FAQ resources to rapidly resolve internal technical inquiries, empowering specialist teams to handle technical discussions confidently.
 

Requirements

Technical Pre-Sales/Consulting - 7+ years of hands-on experience designing and delivering data, analytics, and AI architectures in enterprise environments.

Salesforce Expertise - Hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce and deep fluency with D360 and core Salesforce platform services.

External Ecosystem Knowledge - Strong understanding of external agent ecosystems and interoperability.

Proven Track Record - Experience in prompt engineering, agent lifecycle management, and hands-on prototype development.

AI & ML Expertise - Experience with machine learning concepts (predictive and generative AI), plus the ability to communicate value to diverse audiences.

Data Stack Knowledge - Deep expertise in modern cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift) and data ingestion patterns (batch, streaming, CDC).

Hands-On Development - Proficiency in programming (e.g., JavaScript, Python, SQL, R) and data frameworks like pandas or Jupyter.

Excellent Communication - Strong presentation skills; adept at explaining complex ideas and guiding stakeholders toward impactful solutions.

Curiosity & Continuous Learning - Passion for exploring new AI frameworks, sharing insights, and experimenting with cutting-edge technologies.
 

Preferred Requirements

Advanced Integration - Experience integrating Salesforce with external agents via APIs and open standards (MCP, A2A).

Governance & Observability - Familiarity with prompt governance, observability, and monitoring frameworks.

Cross-Platform Background - Background in cross-platform integrations (e.g., Hyperscaler SDKs to Salesforce Flows).

Multimodal Pipelines - Prior exposure to conversational voice pipelines or multimodal integrations via hyperscaler services.

Advanced AI/ML Frameworks - Exposure to frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), MLOps practices, and cloud AI platforms like Google Vertex AI or AWS Sagemaker.

Education - BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or equivalent technical field.

Customer Accountability and Value Alignment

Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.

AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.

Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.

 Communication: Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.

 Learning & Development: Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development

Salesforce product certifications are a plus (AI Associate, Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, Data Cloud Specialist)

Salesforce is building deep vertical CRM products - disrupting each industry one by one. And just as we invest in building great products, we also invest in ensuring these products are easy to adopt.

This role is in the Product organization, focused on driving adoption of our Agentforce Field Service and Operations platform.

As part of the Product Management team for Field Service, you will support the development of a multi-release roadmap for successful adoption of this product, including per-release strategies on:

How we instrument the product to measure adoption, and the targets we set to define success

How we incorporate new features into Trial Orgs and Sales Demo Orgs to showcase our latest capabilities

How we improve ease of implementation through targeted investments in documentation, enablement, and automated setup

How we can accelerate the efforts of our ecosystem of implementation partners, sales engineers, support agents, and other customer-facing teams to make it easier to help customers get the most value from their Industries product

Although this is an individual contributor role, you will need to bring a “Chief Adoption Officer” mindset as you work closely with product leaders and report progress monthly to the SVP or General Manager for your cloud. As a trusted advisor to these leaders, your strategies will be informed by a variety of firsthand and data-driven sources:

As a member of the product team, you will regularly meet with customer-facing and partner-facing teams (including some customer/partner interaction) to understand the barriers or points of friction they face in embracing their Industries product

As a hands-on expert with the Salesforce platform, you will experience firsthand the level of effort required to configure new features each release, and the extent to which documentation and other supporting assets make the process easier

As a specialist on adoption, you will have support from our adoption data analysts and dashboards to help you identify and analyze usage trends by feature, geography, customer size, tenure, and more.

As a member of the Adoption team, you will be supported by the experience, strategies, and innovations of fellow adoption leads who cover over 20 additional industry-specific products and embedded components

Here is what we need you to bring:

You are a skilled communicator, experienced in presenting to and collaborating with a broad range of senior and executive stakeholders in areas such as Sales, Marketing, Professional Services, Engineering, and Product Management.

You are outspoken and passionate, and do not hesitate to speak your mind - even to those in more senior roles - to advocate for recommended strategies, mitigate risks, or even voice difficult truths in the interest of ensuring successful adoption of your product.

You look forward to getting hands-on to configure new Salesforce features each release, and likely have recent experience configuring Salesforce/Commerce Cloud (or similar) for real-world implementations, demos, or proof of concepts

You understand Product Management, the product development lifecycle, and have experience bringing new innovations to the market

You are passionate about ensuring customers see value from our products, and recognize the importance of rapid and successful adoption as a driver of faster growth and lower attrition for our cloud-based products.

Recommended Qualifications:

10+ years experience influencing and advising senior leaders and decision makers as a consultant, Solution Engineer, Success Manager, or similar roles that show your ability to align functional leaders around a common vision.

5+ years of Salesforce (or similar) implementation consulting, or equivalent experience that demonstrates prior hands-on technical depth as well as understanding of the challenges customers face in adopting new software innovation

5+ years experience in outbound/inbound product management or sales engineering delivering SaaS/cloud solutions

Exemplary verbal and written communication skills, including developing polished presentations for use at the executive level

Ability to work with a degree of ambiguity and flexibility to re-frame and solve adoption challenges

BS or MS in Engineering, Computer Science, or related disciplines or equivalent experience in technical leadership roles. MBA is a plus.

As an Agentforce + Data Cloud Success Architect, you will play a crucial role in driving successful outcomes for our strategic customers by leveraging your technical expertise in data and analytics.

Data Cloud supports seamless integration with Salesforce Marketing, Sales, and Service Clouds, enabling Customer 360 use cases. This ensures that businesses can unify customer data across all touchpoints, enhancing AI-driven marketing automation, personalized engagement, and predictive customer insights. By powering hyper-personalized experiences and real-time decision-making, Data Cloud helps organizations maximize customer lifetime value and drive business growth.
Additionally, Data Cloud is the foundation of Agentforce, enabling real-time, intelligent decision-making by centralizing and harmonizing enterprise data. By leveraging Data Cloud, Agentforce can deliver context-aware AI automation, hyper-personalized customer interactions, and predictive insights, driving greater operational efficiency and business value.
 
Responsibilities:

Be a trusted Agentforce + Data Cloud subject-matter expert for the broader Success Architect organization, including how Data Cloud relates to the success of AI

Engage with our Signature and Strategic customers to evaluate and recommend optimization strategies for technical architecture, dev/ops, performance, and solution design specific to Agentforce + Data Cloud

Identify and evaluate capability gaps for standard product capability or identify creative Architect solutions through customization

Facilitate and influence Executive stakeholders while aligning technology strategy to business value and ROI

Run playbooks aligned with our Success Architect engagement catalog, tailored to the unique needs and opportunities of Agentforce + Data Cloud customers

Build strong relationships with both internal and external business partners, contributing to broader goals and growth

Drive thought leadership through mentoring and knowledge sharing
 

Your Impact

As an Agentforce + Data Cloud Success Architect, you will have a significant impact on our customers' success and the growth of our organization. Your expertise and guidance will directly influence the technical architecture, performance optimization, and solution design strategies for our strategic customers, ensuring their success in leveraging Agentforce + Data Cloud's powerful data capabilities. By driving customer satisfaction and delivering exceptional value, you will contribute to the overall growth and reputation of Salesforce as a leader in the industry.
 
Collaboration and Team Work

Collaboration is at the core of our success, and as an Agentforce + Data Cloud Success Architect, you will have the opportunity to work closely with diverse teams of professionals. You will collaborate with customers, colleagues, and partners to evaluate technical architecture, optimize performance, and design effective solutions. By fostering strong relationships and working collaboratively, you will contribute to the collective success of our teams and the achievement of our goals.
 
Minimum Requirements:

Minimum 2 development/project implementation lifecycles of Salesforce Data Cloud/CDP + AI

 Minimum 8 years proven experience in enterprise consulting, including implementing enterprise software solutions in the Analytics/CDP spaces

Demonstrated ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes focusing on data & integration architecture, with a focus on guiding customers through migration to and optimization of Agentforce + Data Cloud

Deep understanding of data modeling, integration architectures, and data governance best practices

Excellent communication skills, and ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams from Developer to Executive

Ability to facilitate discussions and translate technical concepts & solutions into tangible business value and ROI for customers

Ability to demonstrate basic understanding and stay up-to-date with emerging data-related and AI technologies

Proactive and self-starting attitude with the ability to manage tasks independently while collaborating remotely with customers and colleagues

Values the importance of Data Ethics and Privacy by ensuring that customer solutions adhere to relevant regulations and best practices in data security and privacy

Degree or equivalent experience required. Experience evaluated based on the strengths you'll need for the role (e.g. proven behaviors in previous jobs such as extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
 

Preferred Experience:

Experience in a consulting and implementation Partner for Data Cloud/CDP

Experience with large data such as Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud Storage/Big Query, Azure administration or architecture

Experience with Customer Data platforms such as Segment, Tealium, Adobe Experience Platform, Amperity, Treasure Data, Twilio Segment, Realtio, etc

Experience implementing Salesforce Clouds, Multi cloud scenarios - Sales, Service, Industries, Marketing or Commerce

Familiar with at least one of the Salesforce Architecture Domains: Integration, Access and Identity Management, Data Architecture, Sharing and Visibility, Declarative and APEX Development

Experience in programming languages such as Python, Java, .Net, SQL

Note: This role is office-flexible, and the expectation is to work from the office three days per week.

Shifts - Candidate should be comfortable working in APAC/IST shifts

Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. The Role
The Partner Business Manager (PBM) for ESMB is responsible for the strategic development and tactical execution of our partner sales motion across Malaysia, Indonesia and other emerging ASEAN territories. Unlike the enterprise segment, the ESMB lead must focus on scale, speed, and volume. You will manage a portfolio of partners who specialize in quick-to-value implementations for companies with 0 to 200 employees. This is a high-energy role that requires a "growth-hacker" mindset—balancing the recruitment of new partners with the enablement of existing ones to drive high-velocity revenue.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute a GTM plan specifically for the ESMB segment across Malaysia, Indonesia, and the other emerging markets accounting for local market nuances and economic drivers.

Drive "Partner Sourced" ACV by creating scalable sales plays that allow partners to close deals with minimal friction.

Identify and onboard "Emerging Partners" and local boutique SIs in-region who have a strong footprint in the SMB space.

Work with Partner Enablement to ensure partners can deliver "Fast Start" packages and out-of-the-box solutions tailored for smaller businesses.

Act as the bridge between the ESMB Sales Leaders and the Partner ecosystem to ensure lead-flow is optimized and "white space" in emerging territories is covered.

Promote Salesforce’s value proposition to small business owners and regional entrepreneurs through partner-led marketing initiatives.

Qualifications/Experience

7 to 10 years in Channel Management or Sales, specifically within the SMB/ESMB segment or high-growth tech environments.

Proven experience working within Malaysia, Indonesia and other emerging markets understanding of local business cultures, regulatory environments, and partner landscapes.

Solid understanding of Cloud SaaS, specifically how it scales for smaller organizations with limited IT budgets.

 Ability to manage a high volume of partners and deals simultaneously using data-driven insights to prioritize effort.

A "start-up" mentality—comfortable with ambiguity and capable of building processes where they may not yet exist.

 Proficiency in English is required; knowledge of local languages (e.g., Bahasa Indonesia, Tagalog etc) is a significant advantage for managing regional partners.

Tentang Salesforce

Kami adalah Salesforce, Perusahaan Pelanggan, yang menginspirasi masa depan bisnis dengan AI + Data + CRM. Dengan mengedepankan nilai-nilai inti kami, kami membantu perusahaan di berbagai industri untuk membuka jalan baru dan terhubung dengan pelanggan dengan cara yang benar-benar baru. Dan, kami memberdayakan Anda untuk menjadi Trailblazer — meningkatkan kinerja dan pertumbuhan karier Anda, merintis jalur baru, dan memperbaiki kondisi dunia. Jika Anda percaya bahwa bisnis adalah platform terbaik untuk perubahan dan bahwa perusahaan dapat sukses sambil berbuat baik — Anda telah datang ke tempat yang tepat.

Peran

Manajer Bisnis Mitra (PBM) untuk ESMB bertanggung jawab atas pengembangan strategis dan pelaksanaan taktis dari strategi penjualan mitra kami di Malaysia, Indonesia, dan wilayah ASEAN lainnya yang sedang berkembang. Berbeda dengan segmen korporat, pemimpin ESMB harus fokus pada skala, kecepatan, dan volume. Anda akan mengelola portofolio mitra yang berspesialisasi dalam implementasi cepat yang memberikan nilai tambah bagi perusahaan dengan 0 hingga 200 karyawan. Ini adalah peran yang membutuhkan energi tinggi dan mindset “growth-hacker”—menyeimbangkan perekrutan mitra baru dengan pemberdayaan mitra existing untuk mendorong pendapatan dengan kecepatan tinggi.

Tanggung Jawab Utama

Mengembangkan dan melaksanakan rencana GTM (Go-to-Market) khusus untuk segmen ESMB di Malaysia, Indonesia, dan pasar emerging lainnya, dengan mempertimbangkan nuansa pasar lokal dan faktor pendorong ekonomi.

Meningkatkan ACV (Annual Contract Value) yang dihasilkan oleh mitra dengan menciptakan strategi penjualan yang skalabel, memungkinkan mitra untuk menutup transaksi dengan hambatan minimal.

Mengidentifikasi dan mengintegrasikan “Mitra Baru” dan penyedia layanan lokal (SI) yang memiliki pangsa pasar kuat di segmen SMB.

Bekerja sama dengan Tim Enablement Mitra untuk memastikan mitra dapat menyediakan paket “Fast Start” dan solusi siap pakai yang disesuaikan untuk bisnis kecil.

Bertindak sebagai jembatan antara Pemimpin Penjualan ESMB dan ekosistem mitra untuk memastikan aliran prospek optimal dan area potensial di wilayah berkembang tercakup.

Mempromosikan nilai tambah Salesforce kepada pemilik bisnis kecil dan wirausahawan regional melalui inisiatif pemasaran yang dipimpin mitra.

Kualifikasi/Pengalaman

7 hingga 10 tahun pengalaman di bidang Manajemen Kanal atau Penjualan, khususnya di segmen SMB/ESMB atau lingkungan teknologi yang tumbuh pesat.

This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, platform architecture, and applied AI, requiring you to guide customer Chief Data Officers and Enterprise Architects through emerging AI solutions. You will work side-by-side with Account Executives and Product teams to ensure customers realize the full value of the platform by designing scalable, secure solutions that integrate D360 into complex enterprise ecosystems—including hyperscalers, data lakes, and governance frameworks.

Shape best practices around generative AI, agent interoperability, prompt engineering, Data Cloud, and cross-platform integrations.

Develop thought leadership content—demo templates, whitepapers, enablement sessions—focused on agent lifecycle, integration strategy, and technical effectiveness.

Act as a central technical knowledge resource, proactively addressing internal technical inquiries, facilitating deep technical enablement, and documenting best practices to empower specialist teams across the organization.
 

If you are naturally curious about AI and Data, love diving into new technologies, and enjoy educating others while crafting solutions that deliver real business impact, we want to talk to you!

Responsibilities

Understand Agent Interoperability - Map and integrate external agents from hyperscalers (e.g. Copilot, Gemini) into Agentforce via open standards (MCP, A2A); design how these systems collaborate.

Enable Conversational & Background Agents - Use Agentforce Studio and Agent Builder to configure chat and background agents; integrate with external channels including voice via hyperscaler APIs.

Drive Prompt Engineering & Lifecycle Strategy - Lead prompt design, testing, monitoring, and iteration; define agent lifecycle best practices from development through refinement.

Build Hands-On Demos & Prototypes - Co-create quick prototypes (<2 weeks) with AEs demonstrating integration between Agentforce and external agents or services.

Lead Pre-Sales Workshops - Facilitate whiteboarding, deep-dive sessions, and quick enablement for customers and internal teams.

Advise on Data & Integration - Integrate Data Cloud (D360), CRM, MuleSoft APIs, and external agent endpoints ensuring cohesive architectures that align with compliance and governance policies.

Support Early Adoption - Occasionally assist in proof-of-value engagements post-sale by tuning agents and guiding customers toward self-sufficient enablement.

Own Technical Architecture Decisions - Oversee data modeling, identity resolution, real-time vs. batch patterns, data graph design, and activation strategies within D360.

Own Technical Enablement - Create and manage accessible technical documentation, knowledge bases, and FAQ resources to rapidly resolve internal technical inquiries, empowering specialist teams to handle technical discussions confidently.

External Ecosystem Knowledge - Strong understanding of external agent ecosystems and interoperability.

Proven Track Record - Experience in prompt engineering, agent lifecycle management, and hands-on prototype development.

AI & ML Expertise - Experience with machine learning concepts (predictive and generative AI), plus the ability to communicate value to diverse audiences.

Data Stack Knowledge - Deep expertise in modern cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift) and data ingestion patterns (batch, streaming, CDC).

Your Impact

Own and drive the full technical lifecycle, from deep technical discovery and system design to architecture validation and technical close, across in-person and virtual engagements.

Design and validate end-to-end data architectures integrating Salesforce D360 with enterprise systems (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, streaming platforms, MDM, and source systems).

Own technical architecture decisions, including data modeling, identity resolution, real-time vs. batch patterns, data graph design, and activation strategies within D360.

Partner with Account Executives to shape technical close strategy, grounded in architectural feasibility, scalability, and customer data realities.

Execute hands-on technical validation (POCs, architectural walkthroughs, reference implementations) to de-risk complex deals and accelerate D360 adoption.

Define repeatable industry-specific reference architectures built on D360 that scale across accounts and drive consistent outcomes.

Collaborate deeply with Salesforce Product & Engineering teams to:

Influence roadmap through high-signal Voice of the Customer feedback

Validate architectural patterns against upcoming D360 capabilities

Act as a technical authority during escalations, architecture reviews, and executive-level design discussions.

Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customer Chief Data Officers, Enterprise Architects, and Platform Owners.

Represent Salesforce’s technical point of view for modern data and AI architectures, with D360 as the system of activation, at customer briefings and technical forums.

Qualifications

7+ years of hands-on experience designing and delivering data, analytics, and AI architectures in enterprise environments.

Strong background in data engineering, platform architecture, or technical architecture roles (pre-sales or post-sales).

BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or equivalent technical field (advanced degree preferred).

Proven experience integrating complex, distributed data ecosystems with activation platforms like D360 to drive business outcomes.

Deep expertise in:

Modern cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift)

Data ingestion patterns (batch, streaming, CDC)

Identity resolution, data modeling, and graph-based relationships

Strong technical fluency with Salesforce platform architecture, including D360 and core Salesforce services.

Experience guiding architectural conversations with senior technical stakeholders and influencing platform and data strategy decisions.

Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear architectural guidance for both technical and executive audiences.

Experience operating in large, matrixed organizations with complex stakeholder environments.

Data quality, lineage, governance, and trust frameworks

AI & Analytics

Applied machine learning concepts and AI-readiness architecture on top of D360

Salesforce Admin / Advanced Admin-level proficiency

Role Description

Digital Enterprise Technology (DET) at Salesforce connects people and technology to shape the future of work at Salesforce. Guided by our core values — Trust, Customer Success, Equality, Innovation, and Sustainability — we drive business outcomes that fuel growth, improve productivity, and empower employees and customers globally. DET IT is looking for a Lead Member of the Technical Staff (LMTS) to join our IT Core Finance Engineering team.
This role provides technical leadership and architectural oversight for enterprise finance platforms, including Workday Financials, Vertex tax systems, and the integration ecosystem connecting Quote-to-Cash and Record-to-Report platforms. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in Workday Financials and Vertex tax solutions with strong engineering leadership in enterprise integrations, API architecture, and large-scale financial systems. You will play a critical role in defining the technical strategy, architecture patterns, and engineering standards for finance applications and integrations across the organization.
This role requires a hands-on technical leader who can design complex solutions, mentor engineers, influence architectural decisions, and partner closely with Finance, Tax, Revenue Operations, and Engineering teams to deliver scalable, compliant, and high-performing finance systems.

Responsibilities

Lead the architecture, design, and technical strategy for enterprise finance systems across Workday Financials, Vertex tax systems, and integration platforms.

Define and implement scalable integration architectures connecting ERP, Vertex E Invoicing tool banking platforms.

Provide technical leadership and governance for Workday Financial solutions, including integrations with Salesforce, RevRec systems, Vertex, MuleSoft, and other enterprise applications.

Architect and optimize Vertex tax solutions, including tax determination rules, jurisdictions, exemptions, and compliance reporting.

Define enterprise data flows, transaction mapping, and reconciliation frameworks across upstream and downstream financial systems.

Translate complex finance, tax, and regulatory requirements into robust technical architectures aligned with enterprise standards.

Establish and govern integration standards, including API design, payload structures, security models, error handling, and observability frameworks.

Drive performance, scalability, and reliability improvements for high-volume financial transaction processing.

Mentor and guide engineers through architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making, elevating overall engineering quality.

Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders including Finance, Tax, Product, Business Systems, and system integrators to deliver end-to-end solutions.

Drive adoption of automation, AI-assisted development tools, and modern integration frameworks to improve engineering productivity.

Ensure audit readiness, documentation standards, and compliance with SOX and enterprise governance requirements.

Anticipate future technical needs and evolve architecture patterns, tools, and frameworks to support business growth and global scale.

Required Skills

12+ years of enterprise software engineering experience, with significant experience in finance or ERP platforms.

Deep expertise in Workday Financials and Vertex including architecture, integrations, and technical frameworks.

Strong experience implementing and supporting Vertex tax determination systems in enterprise environments.

Strong knowledge of indirect tax domains, including Sales & Use Tax, VAT, GST, exemptions, and compliance processes.

Extensive experience designing enterprise integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware platforms, and event-driven architectures.

Strong experience with Workday technical capabilities,

Hands-on experience with integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica.

Strong understanding of Quote-to-Cash and Record-to-Report finance processes.

Experience designing secure, scalable API architectures and data integration frameworks.

Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills across financial systems, tax engines, and integration platforms.

Proven ability to lead architecture discussions and influence senior stakeholders across engineering and business teams.

Experience working in Agile environments with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems (Git).

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance Systems, or related field.

Desired Skills

Experience building custom applications using Workday Extend and Orchestrate.

Knowledge of enterprise financial compliance, SOX controls, and audit frameworks.

Experience with automation, RPA, or enterprise testing frameworks.

Exposure to AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar technologies.

Experience designing global tax and finance architectures supporting multi-entity operations.

Delivering customer success with Data + AI + CRM + Trust requires more than product expertise; it requires deep technical architecture leadership. The Data & AI Technical Architect is a senior, hands-on technical architect responsible for designing, validating, and operationalizing enterprise-grade data and AI architectures centered on Salesforce D360 and the Agentforce platform.

This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, platform architecture, and applied AI. You will work directly with customer architects, data engineers, and platform owners to design scalable, secure, and performant solutions that integrate D360 into complex enterprise ecosystems—including hyperscalers, data lakes, real-time pipelines, identity systems, and governance frameworks.

This role owns the technical architecture end-to-end: from deep discovery and system design, through hands-on validation, to production readiness and long-term scalability. Your work establishes the data foundation required for trusted AI, agentic workflows, and measurable business outcomes.

Your Impact

Own and drive the full technical lifecycle, from deep technical discovery and system design to architecture validation and technical close, across in-person and virtual engagements.

Design and validate end-to-end data architectures integrating Salesforce D360 with enterprise systems (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, streaming platforms, MDM, and source systems).

Own technical architecture decisions, including data modeling, identity resolution, real-time vs. batch patterns, data graph design, and activation strategies within D360.

Partner with Account Executives to shape technical close strategy, grounded in architectural feasibility, scalability, and customer data realities.

Execute hands-on technical validation (POCs, architectural walkthroughs, reference implementations) to de-risk complex deals and accelerate D360 adoption.

Define repeatable industry-specific reference architectures built on D360 that scale across accounts and drive consistent outcomes.

Collaborate deeply with Salesforce Product & Engineering teams to:

Influence roadmap through high-signal Voice of the Customer feedback

Validate architectural patterns against upcoming D360 capabilities

Act as a technical authority during escalations, architecture reviews, and executive-level design discussions.

Produce high-fidelity technical assets (architecture diagrams, Demos, governance models, activation patterns) used by field teams, partners, and customers.

Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customer Chief Data Officers, Enterprise Architects, and Platform Owners.

Ensure D360 architectures align to security, privacy, compliance, and trust requirements—especially in regulated industries.

Represent Salesforce’s technical point of view for modern data and AI architectures, with D360 as the system of activation, at customer briefings and technical forums.

Qualifications

You bring progressively senior technical responsibility, including:

7+ years of hands-on experience designing and delivering data, analytics, and AI architectures in enterprise environments.

Strong background in data engineering, platform architecture, or technical architecture roles (pre-sales or post-sales).

BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or equivalent technical field (advanced degree preferred).

Proven experience integrating complex, distributed data ecosystems with activation platforms like D360 to drive business outcomes.

Deep expertise in:

Modern cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift)

Data ingestion patterns (batch, streaming, CDC)

Identity resolution, data modeling, and graph-based relationships

Hands-on proficiency with Python/R, data frameworks (DataFrames, pandas), and analytics workflows (Jupyter).

Strong technical fluency with Salesforce platform architecture, including D360 and core Salesforce services.

Experience guiding architectural conversations with senior technical stakeholders and influencing platform and data strategy decisions.

Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear architectural guidance for both technical and executive audiences.

Experience operating in large, matrixed organizations with complex stakeholder environments.

Technical Skill Set

As a senior technical architect, you bring depth across:

Data Architecture

Cloud data platforms: Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift

Data modeling, identity resolution, entity relationships, D360 data graph design

Batch, real-time, and hybrid ingestion patterns into D360

Data quality, lineage, governance, and trust frameworks

AI & Analytics

Python/R, Jupyter, data wrangling, feature preparation

Applied machine learning concepts and AI-readiness architecture on top of D360

Analytics and BI tools: Tableau, Looker, Power BI

Salesforce Platform

Deep hands-on knowledge of Salesforce architecture

Salesforce Admin / Advanced Admin-level proficiency

Experience designing scalable, secure solutions using D360 as the activation layer across Salesforce Clouds

Work as a team player by contributing, learning and sharing new knowledge

Multiply your efficiency by enabling adjacent teams to position Salesforce’s Analytic Platforms
Drive new technologies such as Data Cloud, Agentforce, and TableauNext
Handle multiple customer engagements concurrently
Attain quarterly and annual objectives assigned by management
Willingness and flexibility to travel as needed

B.S. Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS or equivalent work experience
Minimum of 5-10 years experience in technical pre-sales or consulting
Salesforce Certifications (Admin, Advanced Admin, Data Cloud, Agentblazer) a strong plus
Familiarity with Salesforce’s technical and data architecture - APIs, Custom Objects, APEX Hands-on experience with front end development (JQuery, JavaScript, CoffeeScript)
Hands-on experience with JSON, shell scripting, Python or Java Hands on experience in analyzing data, identifying trends and building visualizations

Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Design, Product Management, and industry experts to build high-quality product features that can be used by major companies around the world.

Establish and scale robust evaluation frameworks by creating domain-specific benchmarks and automated testing suites; implement production telemetry pipelines to monitor real-world model performance, data drift, and system health.

Deep expertise in training large-scale models across distributed systems using frameworks like PyTorch Distributed (DDP/FSDP), DeepSpeed, or TorchTitan on GPU clusters.

Proficiency with Python and PyTorch, Tensorflow, or JAX

Demonstrated ability not only to use state-of-the-art machine learning techniques but also to innovate upon them.

End-to-End MLOps Proficiency: Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade ML pipelines using tools such as Kubeflow, Airflow, or MLflow for experiment tracking, versioning, and automated retraining.

Experience with supply chain, manufacturing, or related problems

We are looking for a thoughtful, talented, and experienced Senior Manager to drive UKI program growth as part of Sales Programs’. Our team is focused on enabling AEs on how to successfully and efficiently create quality, velocity pipe gen while driving Seller Success across the board.

We are looking for impactful and driven people that are passionate about helping sales teams succeed. Every sales play/program we execute has a measurable dollar impact. This role combines the creative process of designing prescriptive programs and strategies, with the “business end” of operationalising these programs with sales teams to ensure they are executed and produce results.

You will be the business partner to one of our Sales Leaders, collaborating closely with him/her and his/her directs to understand their pipe generation needs, becoming their trusted advisor. These skills and competencies will help ensure your success in the role:

* Seasoned executive presence with an ability to read the room fast, adapt to stakeholder needs and build strong relationships
* Demonstrable program management experience in a sales environment; fully knowledgeable of all steps of the sales cycle from lead generation to closing
* Intrinsic urge to network, connect and collaborate, that builds relationships across an organisation and with a continuous curiosity to learn and adapt
* Strong ability to drive best practice in execution acting as an excellent team player, collaborating to create new ideas or utilising what we know works 
* Strong organisational and analytical skills, excellent written and oral communication skills, including experience in executive internal and external discussions
* Structured project manager with an creative approach to creating compelling and engaging sales programs
* Able to manage multiple, competing stakeholders and priorities
* Strong communicator, able to quickly think on your feet, and deal directly with senior sales leaders
* Self-reflective: ability to look at your previous work, objectively evaluate it, learn from it, and adapt and improve
* Believe in open forthright conversations, and are willing to share your opinions in a considered manner, even when the content is challenging

Minimum Requirements

*10 years deep understanding of Sales - whether that is front line Sales, Sales Programs, Sales Strategy or Sales Operations 
* Strong ability to influence and work cross-functionally, and build strong relationship with stakeholders
* Experience designing (or influencing the design of) revenue-producing sales campaigns and/or programs, campaigns and go-to-market strategies
* Ability to draw actionable insights from data sets and interviews with salespeople and sales leaders
* Experience with Salesforce reporting dashboards
* Strong communicator, able to quickly think on their feet, and deal directly with senior sales leaders; proven ability to to manage multiple stakeholders

Partner Across Teams: Work cross-functionally with Sales Strategy, Product Marketing, Enablement, and other teams to coordinate program execution and support seller readiness.

Communicate Program Impact: Develop clear, compelling summaries and visuals to share program insights and recommendations with Sales leaders and stakeholders.

Seller-Centric Program Design: Understands the sales process and what sellers need to be successful.

Analytical Thinking: Interprets quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends and inform decisions.

Program Execution: Experience executing business programs, campaigns, or GTM initiatives.

Strategic & Tactical Agility: Comfortable shifting between big-picture strategy and hands-on execution.

Relationship Building: Builds strong, trusted relationships with sales teams and cross-functional stakeholders; collaborative and resourceful.

Effective Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to simplify complex insights into clear, actionable recommendations.

Organizational Skills: Manages multiple priorities with attention to detail, quality, and alignment across stakeholders.

Adaptability: Thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments; adjusts quickly to changing needs.

Proactive Ownership: Takes initiative, drives work forward independently, and demonstrates accountability.

Team-Oriented Mindset: Values collaboration, continuous learning, and constructive feedback.

2–5 years of experience in Sales Programs, Sales Strategy, Sales Enablement, or Business Operations.

At least 2 years of experience in a cloud-based data or AI company, ideally with exposure to data infrastructure, analytics, AI/ML platforms, or cloud services.

Familiarity with Salesforce CRM; experience using Salesforce dashboards and reports is preferred.

Proficiency in Excel, Tableau, or similar analytics tools; knowledge of SQL is a plus.

Ability to create polished, executive-facing presentations using PowerPoint or Google Slides.

Experience managing cross-functional projects and driving alignment across teams.

Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.

Agentforce Architecture & Technical Leadership:

Engage CIOs, CDOs, and business leaders with outcome-driven architecture narratives and AI roadmaps

Lead executive architecture reviews, vision workshops, and solution strategy sessions

Facilitate agent design workshops and jobs-to-be-done sessions

Develop solution blueprints, architecture proposals, and implementation strategies

Support architecture-led demonstrations and proof-of-value initiatives

Provide architectural governance across implementation lifecycles

Guide integration of Agentforce with Salesforce platform capabilities and enterprise systems

Ensure adherence to best practices for scalability, security, compliance, and operational readiness

Mentor delivery teams and provide design authority across parallel programs

Data 360 for Agentforce:

Architect unified customer data foundations to power context-aware and grounded agents

Design data models, identity resolution strategies, and real-time activation patterns

Establish data ingestion, harmonization, governance, privacy, and security frameworks

Align enterprise data architecture with agent grounding and knowledge retrieval patterns

Internal Enablement & Innovation

Serve as the internal subject matter expert for Agentforce architecture

Build reusable assets, accelerators, and technical reference materials

Deliver internal enablement programs and mentor architects and engineers

Provide field insights and Voice-of-Customer feedback to influence product evolution

10+ years of experience in Technical Architecture, Solution Architecture, or Enterprise Architecture roles

Strong hands-on experience designing and implementing Agentforce solutions in enterprise environments

Strong capability in Agent architecture and orchestration design, Agent configuration, lifecycle management, and governance, Prompt design and optimization, API-led integrations and platform extensibility, Enterprise architecture patterns and technical governance

Executive presence with strong communication and presentation skills

About the Role

Join Salesforce's Detection, Analysis and Response (DAR) team as a CSIRT Senior Incident Manager, where you'll play a critical role in protecting one of the world's leading cloud platforms. In this position, you'll act as Incident Commander for high-severity security incidents and Vulnerability Commander for critical vulnerabilities, leading coordinated response efforts across Salesforce's commercial environments.

What You'll Do
 

Incident & Vulnerability Leadership

Serve as Incident Commander (IC) for high-severity security incidents (Sev 0-2), Customer Owned Security Incidents (COSI) and Vulnerability Commander (VC) for priority vulnerabilities requiring customer action

Lead response strategy and coordination for diverse critical incidents including supply chain attacks, third-party breaches, connected app compromises, large-scale account takeover campaigns, platform vulnerabilities, and insider threats

Establish clear command structures, delegate tasks effectively, and oversee technical workstreams including containment, forensics, and remediation

Ensure timely engagement of stakeholders and maintain accurate, real-time documentation within established SLAs

Training & Preparedness

Develop and conduct security tabletop exercises and drills to enhance organizational readiness

Create training programs for incident response teams and identify gaps in current response plans

Facilitate preparations for future incidents through scenario planning and stakeholder engagement

Process Excellence

Drive continuous improvement of incident management processes, protocols, and playbooks

Lead post-incident lessons learned exercises and develop corrective action programs

Maintain incident response tools, communication channels, and access controls

Review and optimize response procedures based on operational experience

Strategic Integration & Growth

Support security integration for newly acquired companies, including security posture assessments and capability evaluations

Facilitate onboarding tabletop exercises to align acquired organizations with Salesforce incident response processes and expectations

Collaborate with cross-functional security teams during acquisition integration activities

Global Operations

Participate in 24/7 global coverage including rotating weekend and holiday on-call responsibilities

Coordinate seamless handoffs across our three major global regions

Support business continuity planning to ensure effective operations during disruptions

Required Qualifications

Proven experience as an Incident Commander with hands-on leadership of complex security incidents

Deep expertise coordinating responses to critical events such as supply chain attacks, third-party breaches, large-scale campaigns, and platform vulnerabilities

Demonstrated crisis leadership skills with ability to establish command structures and make critical decisions under pressure

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for stakeholder management

Experience developing or managing security programs for organizational preparedness

Proven ability to work effectively in global 24/7 operations

Preferred Qualifications

Industry certifications such as GCIH, CISSP, or CISM

Experience conducting post-mortem exercises and driving process improvements

Background in vendor management and external security engagements

Familiarity with M&A security assessments and integration processes

Experience in highly regulated environments

Knowledge of security automation and case management tools

Location: Sydney (Office-flex arrangement: 3 days in-office)

This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on global security operations while working with cutting-edge technology and a world-class security team. You'll be at the forefront of protecting customers and their data across Salesforce's ecosystem, while contributing to the company's continued growth.

About the Role
The Global Partnerships, Partner Systems & Innovation team is seeking a Hyperscaler Systems & Operations Manager to join the team steering the expansion of Salesforce’s global hyperscaler marketplace engine. We are seeking a strategic operator who can navigate the interplay of quote-to-cash architecture and hyperscaler platform evolution without introducing technical latency. This role moves beyond standard project management to help define the global launch frameworks that accelerate time-to-market while navigating deep-dive technical and regulatory discovery. You will join a team architecting the systems and automated workstreams required to resolve complex business challenges into high-fidelity, scalable solutions.

You will direct the alignment between cross-functional stakeholders, product roadmaps, and joint strategies with both internal SMEs and hyperscaler partners. This requires a deep understanding of both SaaS and consumption-based revenue models and the ability to influence partner product development through data-driven insights. You will drive the technical governance necessary to support complex pricing models and private offer operations, ensuring sales teams have the expert guidance required to close high-stakes deals. We are looking for a pragmatist who can manage high-impact workstreams concurrently while maintaining the grit to solve for legacy bottlenecks.

Responsibilities will include:
- Concurrently managing multiple high impact and high visibility workstreams assisting in the design, development & optimization of business systems & processes to successfully execute & scale Salesforce transactions via Hyperscaler marketplaces.
- Execute deep-dive technical and regulatory discovery for new regions, proactively identifying local tax obligations, invoicing requirements, and technical hurdles to accelerate launch timelines and ensure compliance.
- Lead end-to-end global geographic expansion of Hyperscaler Marketplaces into new territories, managing the entire lifecycle from initial pre-discovery through to General Availability.
- Oversee complex financial workstreams, such as the implementation of multi-currency support and the optimization of international tax invoicing and disbursement processes to reduce manual overhead.
- Evolve the "Global Launch Framework" (Country Launch Matrix) to provide leadership with data-driven estimates on time-to-market, resource requirements, and risk.
- Strategize for infrastructure and platform shifts, such as Sovereign Cloud requirements or new contracting models, ensuring the marketplace motion remains compliant, functional, and aligned with the latest hyperscaler foundational capabilities.
- Author and institutionalize standard operating procedures, internal playbooks, and technical documentation to ensure repeatable, scalable marketplace execution across all global regions.
- Monitor industry best practices and Hyperscaler feature releases to ensure the marketplace motion remains modern, competitive, and aligned with evolving buyer behavior and platform capabilities.
- Serve as a thought leader for Marketplace strategy, identifying opportunities where platform expertise can drive broader GTM impact and cross-functional efficiency across the organization.
- Facilitate high-impact workshops between internal stakeholders, sales teams and Hyperscaler partners to align on international product roadmaps and joint GTM strategies.
- Act as a primary liaison with Hyperscaler partners, influencing their product development by presenting data-driven insights regarding internal pain points and requested feature enhancements.
- Provide dedicated deal support to Partner Sales Managers and sales teams, offering expert guidance on private offer governance, complex pricing models, and discounting frameworks.

The ideal candidate would have:
- Have 5+ years of experience in Hyperscaler GTM systems, revenue operations, and/or business systems, with at least 2+ years in a leadership role managing teams
- Have built and scaled GTM systems infrastructure at organizations generating $1B+ in annual revenue.
- Possess expertise in Salesforce architecture, including experience with enterprise-scale implementations supporting complex sales processes and integrations.
- Have hands-on experience partnering on quote-to-cash processes (billing, order management, revenue recognition) and understand how CRM and CPQ systems integrate with downstream financial workflows.
- Have experience with consumption-based or usage-based revenue models in addition to traditional SaaS contract structures.
- Have experience with international GTM operations and multi-currency, multi-entity commercial systems.
- Demonstrate a track record of effective cross-functional partnership with Finance, Legal, Sales Leadership, and Engineering teams.
- Bring strong people leadership skills with experience building and developing teams in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

We support product strategy, user experience, and customer success across core infrastructure and services, data, integration, AI, and analytics to redefine the future of enterprise software and evolve the way we work.

We are seeking a Principal Researcher who can distill complex problems into insights that inform product, design, development, and business decisions. The ideal candidate will have domain expertise in AI and data platforms — think unstructured data and metadata processing, AI guardrails and governance, Agent building and observability, and API management and integrations. This role will work cross-functionally across highly technical teams, helping to root strategy in action; manage collaborative efforts across multiple research initiatives; and focusing on customer value above all else. At bare minimum, we require familiarity with enterprise software, particularly “as-a-service,” and its evolving personas (Admins, Developers, Data Engineers, BI, IT, CIOs, CDOs). Experience with enterprise AI adoption, data solutions and integration capabilities, along with advanced competency across mixed research methods, will be a value add.

Sound like you? Then you're someone we want to work with. Join our amazing team and you'll get to work with some of the best and brightest. You'll find startup-like scrum teams, consumer-style innovation, and the opportunity to deliver great experiences to millions of end-users. And, by the way, you’ll work for a company that has been named – 10 years running – in Fortune 100 Top Places to work.

Your Impact

Scope and drive full research initiatives, including planning, developing, and executing studies, managing stakeholders, triangulating data, and translating insights into actions

Proactively partner with senior management across cross-functional teams, including product, design, engineering, and customer success to identify and advocate for product strategy rooted in data and customer insights

Conduct strategic, generative, and evaluative research using the appropriate mix of research methods, from large-scale survey design to in-depth interviews 

Synthesize research findings into actionable insights by creating narratives to frame problems and highlight the business value of recommended solutions 

Work on fast-paced and oftentimes ambiguous projects and programs, requiring attention to detail and working within constrained timelines, by staying true to scope and focusing on end goals and outcomes

Contribute back to the broader Research & Insights organization through mentorship, cultivating and teaching craft and methodology, and facilitating deep collaboration across individuals and teams

Minimum Requirements

10+ years of experience conducting research in product research, user research, or other technology contexts

Advanced understanding of research methods (qualitative and quantitative) and best practices, and familiarity with a broad range of user research tools

Excellent project management, communication, storytelling, and presentation skills

Advanced understanding in survey methodologies and tools (i.e. MaxDiff, Conjoints, segmentation, advanced analytics, SPSS, R)

Proven track record influencing product direction and strategy with actionable insights

Ability to plan, design, execute and communicate both strategic and tactical research engagements

Ability to structure and lead internal and external workshops and analyze the outcomes to provide insight for stakeholders

Experience working in cross-functional teams (e.g. customer success, solution architects, design, product management, engineering, marketing)

University degree in a research- or business-focused discipline or in a field emphasizing human behavior (e.g., Psychology, Anthropology, HCI, Business, Research Methodology, Experimental Design, Design Research)

Please provide 1-2 case studies of research projects you led. Please redact or anonymize any proprietary data, company names, or specific product features to comply with existing NDAs. We are most interested in your methodology, stakeholder management, and how your insights influenced product strategy.

The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Who we are:

The Sales Programs team partners with our Sales Leaders to identify potential pipeline and/or revenue gaps, build new initiatives and programs to drive results that we measure on an ongoing basis. Our team deploys a mix of strategy, operations and analytics to help our Sales teams drive productivity and close deals.

We sit at the intersection of the most pressing issues for the business and serve as Business Partners to our Sales Leaders. We also regularly work and align with Marketing, Business Development, Enablement, Strategy, Product Specialist etc which allows a comprehensive understanding of the business we address.

The pace and environment is very much start-up like, still with the level of support big corporations can provide. Our team includes a diverse mix of strategy, marketing, sales and consulting backgrounds. We strongly believe that diversity in background and thought is crucial to the success of our team.

We are looking for someone who is data-driven, naturally curious, and eager to work on innovative solutions to challenging business problems.

What you will do:

You will help drive the continued success of our Sales Program Managers by supporting our growth strategy. You will help us to create reports and dashboards to contribute to decision making, you will support in the communication of results of programs in Latin America, you will help Sales Program Managers to update the results of their sales campaigns and you will have an approach to the global team so that together let's evaluate good practices for the region

Qualifications:

You are graduating either on July 2027 or December 2027. 

You have strong interpersonal skills and will enjoy working collaboratively with other teams

You show strong listening and communication skills

Ability to demonstrate strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills

Entrepreneurial drive, resilience and a “getting things done” attitude to overcome challenges and achieve goals in a fast-paced environment

Ability to leverage AI usage creatively

An open personality with a clear desire to learn and develop

Advanced English proficiency is required

You are passionate about Salesforce’s mission

What we offer:

Being part of challenging projects, that will allow you to improve your skills to become an amazing professional at the end of the program;

Participating in a 1 year program with special activities and swag besides the on-the-job formation;

Competitive salary;

Wellness Reimbursement, meal vouchers, paid holidays and other Salesforce benefits!

Important information:

Start Date: May 18th, 2026

Location: Mexico City

Part-time: 6 hours a day

Lenght: This is a 1-year long internship program

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Who we Are
We are an ambitious team of doers, designers, entrepreneurs, engineers, strategists, and storytellers passionate about developing ideas and delivering working solutions. Here you’ll find a transformative pre-sales innovation team within the world’s most innovative company—according to Forbes, not just us—and we’re looking for the best talent around the globe.

Who you Are
If you are curious, proactive, committed, creative and passionate about getting hands-on with technology, interested in AI, AI oriented and eager to start your career in an innovative environment, you are perfect for us!

You are a creative, tech-enthusiast and like technically challenging scenarios, which will be solved using the full power of the Salesforce platform.

Through the internship you will demonstrate your team work, collaboration and proactivity skills while working with your peers on Q Branch and Solution Engineers while at the same time you get expertise on Salesforce solutions, including Sales, Service, Marketing and Experience Clouds. Consider this your introduction to the sales organization, spend some time learning, and be on your way to an exciting career at Salesforce

What You’ll Do

The Early Solution Engineering program is divided in two different phases, in each one you’ll be provided with the knowledge and information you will need to become in a successful Solution Engineer.

During the first half of the program, you’ll be working in the Q Branch team. Here you’ll be able to learn and put hands on the Demo Engineer role and develop technical skills; your work will have a significant impact on our Solution Engineering success by designing and implementing creative demo solutions for our customers across Latin America.

The second half of the program is about sharpening your selling and consulting skills, working hand by the hand with the best Solution Engineers (pre-sales consultants) of the region to finally be fully prepared with all that you will need to be an SE - as we call them - .

You will be working side by side with your Q Branch Demo Engineers fellows and with a variety of Solution Engineers (pre-sales consultants) across Latin America to:

Create innovative, creative and intelligent solutions by developing in the Salesforce platform.

Design and build solutions using Salesforce solutions, both in declarative and programmatic manners.

Develop demonstration preparation skills and presentation skills.

Develop and execute strategic projects that will help the Solution Engineering team in the long term.

Provide support to the Solution Engineering team building demonstrations, prototypes, RFPs and other related activities.

During the 2nd half of the program you’ll be able to participate in customer meetings and doing presentations as well as be part of Account planning processes.

As an intern you will be assigned with a Trailguide, a peer that will help with your onboarding, so fear not!

What we offer:

12 month internship.

In-depth training in our solutions

Great benefits

Challenging, dynamic and fun working environment

Need to have

English fluency: strong language skills (spoken and written due preparation material and certification exams are in English).
Proactivity, initiative and sense of curiosity.
Ability to work independently and with a team essential.
Self-motivated, desire to learn and self-study.
AI oriented.
Great communication skills

Nice to have

Knowledge of Java, Javascript, JQuery, HTML5, CSS and other web technologies is an advantage;
Previous Salesforce knowledge or Salesforce Certifications
Experience in UX or UI design.

概要
セールスストラテジーは営業組織のための社内コンサルティングを行う組織であり、その中においてストラテジー・マネージャーは重要な役割を担います。マネージャーは、会社の業績や市場機会に関する主要指標を分析し、営業組織のための戦略テーマを設定し、シニアリーダーへの提言・プレゼンテーションを行う責任を持ちます。組織設計、事業計画、市場セグメンテーション・カバレッジ最適化、営業業績評価などのプロジェクトに関わります。精緻な分析モデル、業績分析、各種ダッシュボード、社内幹部向けプレゼンテーション資料などが求められる成果物です。シニアエグゼクティブ層と定期的に議論の場を持ちます。

業務内容

シニアエグゼクティブ向けプレゼンテーションの作成・実施

幹部の意思決定をサポートする日常的なビジネスパフォーマンス分析

拡張可能なレポート・ツールによる分析モデルの設計・構築

営業組織や関連部門との定期的な情報共有と改善活動

市場の理解、および革新的な顧客獲得施策の考案のための定性的および定量的なデータ分析、社内外へのリサーチ

Go-To-Marketモデルの最適化に必要な分析モデルの設計

社内関係者や社外協力会社（マーケティング専門会社、データベンダー、パートナー）と協業の下での複数のプロジェクト・施策の管理・運営

米国本社や国外関係会社との情報交換および折衝

日本市場における最重要課題を特定し、解決策をドライブする

中長期的なアスピレーショナルゴールを達成するため、カントリーマネージャー/リーダーシップチームと協働し、長期戦略 (投資計画・GTM戦略）の策定・実行まで推進

ローカルとグローバルリーダーシップに向けて、 四半期事業報告（QBR）資料を作成

必須要件

財務分析モデリングや表計算スキルに長けていること、データベース分析の経験

具体的な行動につながる分析・提言ができる、実行可能で現実的な施策をデザインできる

自発的に行動できる、求められるタスク以上の成果を目指す意欲がある

プロジェクト管理の経験

ベンチャー企業のスピード感を持ち、目標に向けて周囲を巻き込みながら協働できる

流暢レベルの日本語と英語(TOEIC800以上相当)でコミュニケーションがとれる

望ましいスキルと経験

Job Details
The Strategy Manager will play a critical role in the Sales Strategy group, a team which acts as the company’s internal consulting arm for the fast growing sales organization The selected candidate will share responsibility for identifying and reporting on key indicators of sales performance and market opportunity, using those findings to set the strategic agenda for the sales group, and presenting recommendations to senior leaders. Projects will include business planning, market segmentation, coverage optimization, and ongoing performance measurement. Deliverables range from robust analytic models, custom performance analysis, scalable reporting infrastructure, and the packaging of findings into presentation-ready content for salesforce.com executives.
The successful candidate will possess a passion for creating scalable, repeatable analytics, and innovative analysis, and the wherewithal to develop findings and recommendations that transcend the numbers. Ideally, this person will have worked or interned at a management consultancy, in a product management role or acted in a similar capacity at another firm, and will feel comfortable interacting with senior management on a regular basis.

Responsibilities:

Assist in developing and delivering presentations for senior executives

Create and productize the analytics required to drive improvements in our partnership model

Support ongoing analysis of business performance required to inform executive decisions on a daily basis

Take ownership in managing several programs, operationally, in collaboration with relevant parties within Salesforce as well as with outside parties (marketing firms, data vendors, partners)

Expand the analytical infrastructure with scalable reports and tools

Work cross-functionally to establish reporting standards

Qualitative and quantitative data analysis, researches and ideas exchange within and outside of salesforce for understanding customer/market landscape as well as to generate innovative programs to accelerate customer acquisition

Drive the most critical strategic initiatives for Japan market

Plan, develop and implement Long-term Plan (LRP) with close alignment with country manager and leadership teams to achieve Salesforce long-term aspirational goal.

Create executive-level presentations for both local and global leadership Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR)

Minimum Requirements: 

Expert financial modeling and Excel skills; experience using databases for analysis is a plus

Creativity and practicality in developing actionable recommendations and programs

Self-starter and high degree of motivation to go above and beyond the task at hand

Project management experience and operational excellence

Ability to succeed in a collaborative, start-up paced environment

Ability to communicate both in fluent Japanese and English (TOEIC score over 800 or equivalent)

Preferred Requirements: 

Degree from University degree, preferably in an analytical discipline such as engineering, computer science, economics, etc.

Work experience in consulting, finance, or product management is desired

Experience in building strategy of partnership or leading partnership within Strategy team is desired

Experience in enabling/training new employees and inexperienced members in analysis and reporting

Highly preferred : Experience running analysis using salesforce.com, Tableau CRM, or Tableau

Work experience in data extraction, data formatting, and big data analysis using SQL
