We are looking for a high-potential seller who thrives on the "thrill of the chase" and has the strategic patience to win long-cycle enterprise deals.

The Hunter Instinct: You have a proven track record of opening doors in "locked" accounts. You are energised by the challenge of building a presence from zero.

Intellectual Curiosity: You are a fast learner. You are eager to master the nuances of the HLS landscape—from GxP compliance and clinical data silos to the evolving digital needs of Commercial Excellence and Medical Affairs departments.

Executive Presence: You can navigate a boardroom and hold your own with CIOs, CMOs, and Digital Transformation leaders.

Resilience & Coachability: You view "no" as a request for more information. You are a fast learner who actively seeks feedback to sharpen your sales craft.

Complex Problem Solving: You don't just sell software; you solve business bottlenecks for organisations that impact global human health.

High Visibility: This role offers a direct line of sight to leadership and a clear path for career acceleration into the upper echelons of enterprise sales.

What is an Account Solution Engineer?

Also known as a “Presales”, “Solution Advisor”, “Sales Consultant,” or “Sales Engineer” the Account Solution Engineer is responsible for owning the solutions throughout the sales cycle and delivering thought leadership to companies to transform their customer’s experience. The Account SE is an expert who works alongside their colleagues, participates in building our team culture and supports their aligned sales team to create solutions for prospects and customers.
To ensure our impact is both deep and relevant, our Solution Engineers specialize by industry. For this role, you will focus on the Manufacturing vertical in the Netherlands—working with process and discrete manufacturers to optimize operations, enhance supply chain visibility, and drive digital transformation.
To accomplish this, you should have a strong desire to set the vision translating business objectives into enticing and practical recommendations. The Account SE acts as a trusted advisor to our customers while aiding the customer’s transformational journey.

Your Responsibilities

Enable Digital Transformation: Partner with customers to shape their digital journeys using market-leading CRM and AI Agent technology tailored to industry needs.

Trusted Advisory: Listen to customer needs and translate business challenges—from production planning to aftermarket service—into recommendations that demonstrate clear value to both business leaders and IT stakeholders.

Solution Orchestration: Coordinate with internal teams to design tailored solution concepts and technical Proof of Concepts (POCs) that address real-world manufacturing challenges.

Technical Engagement: Build and share compelling demonstrations that highlight the capabilities of the Salesforce platform and our partner ecosystem, with a focus on manufacturing use cases.

Relationship Building: Present compelling solutions while developing industry expertise and articulating benefits to stakeholders at every level, from plant floor supervisors to C-level executives. Bridge the gap between initial vision and program execution by driving deeper platform adoption and measurable business impact.

Drive Value & Consumption
Bridge the gap between vision and execution by ensuring customers maximize their investment. You will partner with Success Managers to track key performance indicators (KPIs), identify underutilized features, and propose roadmap expansions that drive deeper platform adoption and measurable business impact.

Personality Attributes & Experience

Consultative & Empathetic: A background in solution engineering, consultancy, or software delivery with a natural ability to connect business goals to technology.

Communication & Connection: Good presentation and interpersonal skills, with a talent for explaining complex ideas in an engaging and accessible way.

Growth Mindset: A passion for technology and a desire to continuously learn, experiment, and share new knowledge with the wider team.

Collaborative Spirit: A proven ability to contribute to and support teams in dynamic, evolving environments. We value diverse perspectives and encourage everyone to bring their unique voice to the table.

Diverse Backgrounds Welcome: Track record of solution engineering, consultancy, delivery, or training success. We are open to a variety of backgrounds for this role. Experience will be evaluated based on core proficiencies (e.g., extracurricular leadership, work experience, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications & Skills

Language & Location: Fluency in Dutch and English is required. Willing and able to travel occasionally throughout the Netherlands.

Salesforce Ecosystem: Experience with Salesforce (or similar) solutions (Sales, Service, Data 360, Agentforce,..). Salesforce certifications are a plus but not an absolute requirement.

Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with or an interest in manufacturing use cases, including production planning (S&OP), supply chain optimization, and digital twins.

Solution & Communication Skills: Ability to understand customer business goals and map those to the right technology solutions on the Salesforce platform and within our ecosystem of partners. Solid verbal, written, and presentation skills.

The Technical Architect - DevOps ensures solutions align with industry best practices to drive long-term customer success. This hands-on role involves architectural work and, when necessary, deployment execution. You are both a big-picture thinker and an in-depth problem solver, with broad and deep technical expertise. You take pride in designing resilient systems that withstand high volumes and critical demands while balancing technical and enterprise-level considerations.

Responsibilities

Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and manage expectations.

Assess existing DevOps processes, tools, and practices, recommending improvements.

Design, present, and implement best-fit DevOps solutions, considering customer needs, tool preferences, and commercial constraints.

Drive the selection and implementation of DevOps tools and technologies.

Lead DevOps design sessions, architect solutions, and document best practices.

Develop and enforce DevOps frameworks and governance models for consistency across deployments.

Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects.

Ensure successful continuous delivery deployments across environments.

Support pre-sales activities, including discovery sessions, technical deep dives, and proof-of-concept (PoC) development.

Collaborate with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations.

Travel to client sites as needed (estimated 50-75%).

Requirements (Technical Skillset)

9+ years of CRM experience, with at least 8 years on the Salesforce platform.

Expert knowledge of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Experience, Industries (Vlocity), and Data Cloud.

Strong understanding of environment management, release management, version control best practices, and deployment methodologies.

Understanding of branching strategies such as Git Flow, Trunk-based development, Feature branching

Salesforce Development Lifecycle – Metadata API, SFDX (Salesforce DX), Salesforce CLI, Apex, SOQL, Lightning Web Components (LWC).

Experience with CI/CD tools: Copado, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, CircleCI.

Experience managing code quality tools (e.g., SonarQube, Checkmarx, PMD).

Understanding of Performance Monitoring – Salesforce Event Monitoring, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor.

Experience with security integration into CI/CD pipelines.

Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Technology, or equivalent experience.

Salesforce certifications (active or ability to obtain upon hire).

Account Executive - Secteur Public (Tableau )

Tableau aide le monde entier à voir et à comprendre les données. En tant que cœur analytique de l'écosystème Salesforce, notre plateforme permet aux organisations de transformer des données complexes en décisions stratégiques grâce à l'IA et aux agents intelligents.

Le secteur public est le marché qui connaît la croissance la plus rapide chez Salesforce au niveau mondial. En France, Tableau affiche une croissance annuelle moyenne de 65 % sur les cinq dernières années.

Nous avons posé les fondations ; nous entrons désormais dans une phase d'accélération massive. Nous recherchons un(e) Account Executive de haut niveau pour piloter l'expansion de Tableau auprès des collectivités territoriales (Régions, Départements, Métropoles et Communes).

En tant qu'ambassadeur de notre solution, vous êtes responsable du développement de Tableau sur votre territoire. Vos objectifs principaux :

Stratégie de conquête : Définir et exécuter des plans de comptes audacieux alignés sur les agendas de transformation des acteurs publics locaux.

About the Role 
The Sales Strategy team is a vital strategic partner, supporting the sales leadership team as a trusted advisor focused on strategic planning, sales optimization, and business operational support. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including finance, employee success, marketing, recruiting and operations.

This is a high-impact position with evolving priorities. You will be empowered to think strategically, design focused execution plans, and guide those plans to fruition. Your projects will range from high-level strategy to vital operations, focusing on areas such as Go-To-Market planning, playbooks, territory alignment, data quality, market segmentation, and business performance reviews.

Market Analysis: Conduct ad-hoc analyses across multiple data sets and tools (e.g., customer segmentation, sales participation, propensity to buy, white space).

Operational Excellence: Guide forecast management to ensure sustained, predictable growth across business units, and coordinate weekly forecast calls to track sales pursuits.

Executive Storytelling: Create compelling executive-level presentations for local and global leadership reviews, and organize quarterly business reviews.

Process Improvement: Proactively troubleshoot operational issues as they surface, proposing systemic and process changes to address root causes.

What You’ll Bring (Required):

Strategic Background: Proven experience (typically 5+ years) in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or strategic business operations—ideally within an online/startup, SaaS, or sales/business development environment.

Language Skills: Full professional fluency in both English and German.

Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to turn complex data into actionable strategies.

Mindset: A proactive, solutions-oriented approach with a focus on achieving shared goals in a fast-paced environment.

Creating a culture of Equality isn’t just the right thing to do, it’s also the smart thing- that’s why at Salesforce Equality is one of our top values. We are looking for inquisitive individuals with a passion for sales to join our Sales Development team.

We know that great candidates don’t always apply to job ads if they don’t hit 100% of the criteria, and we don’t want to miss out on an opportunity to meet people, like you! Even if you don’t tick every box but you’re curious and driven, we’d love to hear from you.
 

Launch Your Career in Tech 

Are you looking for a way to break into the dynamic world of Tech and SaaS? The Sales Development Representative (SDR) role is your starting point, designed to build a strong foundation for your career, no matter what your current background is. We value the unique skills and perspectives you bring.

Role in a Nutshell

As a SDR, you'll be a vital first connection for potential customers. You will be a problem-solver and a strategist, responsible for:

Generating new business opportunities by identifying and connecting with potential customers.

Developing and qualifying these opportunities through strategic, targeted outreach.

Working in close partnership with our Sales and Marketing teams to fuel our collective success.

Explore the Future of AI

In this quickly evolving landscape, we are committed to delivering trusted AI solutions. You'll be at the forefront, helping customers navigate this innovative environment.

We're Invested in Your Growth 

Does this sound a little bit out of your comfort zone? Don't worry. We are deeply

invested in your personal and professional success. We provide a comprehensive and supportive environment to ensure you have all the tools you need. You'll receive:

In-depth training on our products, processes, and sales methodologies.

Continuous guidance from dedicated leaders, mentors, and your peers.

A collaborative team culture where curiosity is celebrated and questions are encouraged.

How We Measure Success 

This is a sales role, and we believe in being transparent about success.

Your impact will be measured through clear, achievable monthly goals for qualified opportunities and team-closed business.

We are looking for individuals who are self-motivated, resilient, and thrive in a

goal-oriented environment and we provide the supportive framework to help you hit those goals!

 

A Day in the Life of a SDR:

Commit to ongoing learning and development

Contribute to a diverse and engaged team

Work with partners across a breadth of industries and verticals

Qualifying leads, contacts and accounts to understand use case and opportunity 

Maintain active engagement with new and existing leads through creative follow-up 

Partner closely with Account Executives to move qualified pipeline through the sales cycle

Building a point of view on how to help qualify customers needs

Speaking to value and return on investment vs. technical functionality

Establishing credibility and trust with internal and external partners

Demonstrating adaptability and flexibility as part of an ever-growing sales organisation

Achieve monthly quota related to opportunities generated

We're Looking For 

Engaging, clear communicators

Growth mindset and willingness to learn

A bias for acton and achievement

A mentality of getting it done and putting in the work

Ability to think on your feet and find solutions in-flight

Experience prospecting and cold calling (highly regarded)

Consistent achievement of target or critical metrics

Ability to quickly grasp and distinctly explain technological and business concepts

PASSION: Passionate about Customer Success

Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together technical architects, customer support engineers, and product advisors. This team delivers expert guidance on optimizing and demonstrating Salesforce technology to drive long-term business success, in addition to resolving technical issues.

Success Architects are a pivotal part of the Cloud Success team, supporting Salesforce’s most critical and strategic customers. They provide expert guidance on solution design, focusing on scalability, security, and adherence to standard methodologies. By assessing system performance, they help to optimize efficiency and reliability while proactively identifying risks and recommending improvements to maintain technical health. Success Architects empower businesses to maximize their Salesforce investment by aligning technology with core business goals.

The Industry Success Architect collaborates across Customer Success and the Product organization to drive long-term customer solutions. This includes resolving immediate technical challenges with support engineers while identifying root causes, partnering with customer success managers on strategic guidance and long-term technology health, and liaising with product teams to surface customer feedback for product improvements.

Key Responsibilities:

As an Industry Success Architect, you will specialize in multiple Industry Clouds with primary, secondary, and tertiary areas of expertise. You will:

Drive Customer Impact - Partner with our most strategic and high-priority customers, assessing their Industry Cloud implementations and delivering expert recommendations on technical architecture, solution design, application lifecycle management, reliability, and feature adoption.

Lead with Multi-Cloud Expertise - Serve as a trusted Subject Matter Expert (SME) in your designated Industry Clouds, providing both proactive and reactive guidance on architecture, technology strategy, thought leadership, and product best practices. You will help the team stay at the forefront of Industry Cloud innovations, ensuring they are equipped with the latest product developments and emerging trends.

Communicate with Clarity - Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to executive leadership, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor in key business and technology discussions.

Innovate & Solve Problems - Identify capability gaps and design inefficiencies, recommending product enhancements or creative custom solutions that drive customer success and long-term adoption.

Execute Proven Strategies - Leverage and tailor Success Architect playbooks to meet the unique challenges and opportunities of your Industry Cloud customers.

Build Strong Relationships - Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement, and overall business growth.

Required Multi-Cloud Aptitude:

We are looking for individuals with expertise spanning multiple Industry Clouds (Primary, Secondary, and Tertiary) from the following list. Prioritization of these clouds is geographically diverse, but we are primarily seeking skills in:

Life Sciences Cloud

Public Sector

Financial Services Cloud

Revenue Cloud & Billing

Manufacturing Cloud

Automotive Cloud

Education Cloud

Net Zero Cloud

Non-Profit

Loyalty Cloud

5+ years of experience in software, system, or enterprise architecture.

Expertise in Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance, and best practices.

Experience with large-scale, complex implementations, including SaaS, PaaS, multi-tenancy, and multi-tiered infrastructure.

Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics, and security best practices.

2. Communication & Leadership

Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options, and drive stakeholder alignment.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and executive audiences.

Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.

Proven ability to lead discussions, influence decision-making, and advocate for best practices.

3. Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving

Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations, and drive customer transformation.

Provide data-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.

Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.

Salesforce Development: Hands-on experience with APEX programming, JavaScript, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC). Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution.

Data Management & Integration: Proficient in designing and managing data models, validation rules, and data governance best practices. Experience with data import/export, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs and middleware (e.g., MuleSoft).

System Integration & Extensibility: Strong understanding of integrating Salesforce with other enterprise systems using APIs, middleware, and event-driven architectures. Experience working with OAuth, Platform Events, External Objects, and tools like Salesforce Connect.

OmniStudio Knowledge: Experience with OmniStudio components is required.

DevOps (Core + Industry): Strong understanding of software development and delivery process, assessing architecture environments and requirements in order to implement management solutions.

Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. Agentforce is Salesforce's newest innovation—a next-generation platform that combines Data + AI + CRM + Trust to transform customer experiences. Our AI and Data Architect team is a startup within a global organization, dedicated to helping Salesforce customers and prospects design and implement cutting-edge solutions that deliver real business value.

Role Description

As an AI and Data Technical Architect, you will act as a senior, hands-on technical leader and trusted advisor to our customers. You will be responsible for designing, validating, and operationalizing enterprise-grade data and AI architectures centered on Salesforce D360 and the Agentforce platform. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, platform architecture, and applied AI, requiring you to guide customer Chief Data Officers and Enterprise Architects through emerging AI solutions. You will work side-by-side with Account Executives and Product teams to ensure customers realize the full value of the platform by designing scalable, secure solutions that integrate D360 into complex enterprise ecosystems—including hyperscalers, data lakes, and governance frameworks.
 

You will:

Lead pre-sales technical design by analyzing customer needs and recommending solutions aligned with Agentforce capabilities and integration with external agent frameworks.

Shape best practices around generative AI, agent interoperability, prompt engineering, Data Cloud, and cross-platform integrations.

Collaborate with AEs and SEs to build hands-on prototypes and demos using Agentforce and integrated external agents.

Develop thought leadership content—demo templates, whitepapers, enablement sessions—focused on agent lifecycle, integration strategy, and technical effectiveness.

Act as a central technical knowledge resource, proactively addressing internal technical inquiries, facilitating deep technical enablement, and documenting best practices to empower specialist teams across the organization.
 

If you are naturally curious about AI and Data, love diving into new technologies, and enjoy educating others while crafting solutions that deliver real business impact, we want to talk to you!
 

Responsibilities

Understand Agent Interoperability - Map and integrate external agents from hyperscalers (e.g. Copilot, Gemini) into Agentforce via open standards (MCP, A2A); design how these systems collaborate.

Enable Conversational & Background Agents - Use Agentforce Studio and Agent Builder to configure chat and background agents; integrate with external channels including voice via hyperscaler APIs.

Drive Prompt Engineering & Lifecycle Strategy - Lead prompt design, testing, monitoring, and iteration; define agent lifecycle best practices from development through refinement.

Build Hands-On Demos & Prototypes - Co-create quick prototypes (<2 weeks) with AEs demonstrating integration between Agentforce and external agents or services.

Lead Pre-Sales Workshops - Facilitate whiteboarding, deep-dive sessions, and quick enablement for customers and internal teams.

Advise on Data & Integration - Integrate Data Cloud (D360), CRM, MuleSoft APIs, and external agent endpoints ensuring cohesive architectures that align with compliance and governance policies.

Support Early Adoption - Occasionally assist in proof-of-value engagements post-sale by tuning agents and guiding customers toward self-sufficient enablement.

Own Technical Architecture Decisions - Oversee data modeling, identity resolution, real-time vs. batch patterns, data graph design, and activation strategies within D360.

Own Technical Enablement - Create and manage accessible technical documentation, knowledge bases, and FAQ resources to rapidly resolve internal technical inquiries, empowering specialist teams to handle technical discussions confidently.
 

Requirements

Technical Pre-Sales/Consulting - 7+ years of hands-on experience designing and delivering data, analytics, and AI architectures in enterprise environments.

Salesforce Expertise - Hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce and deep fluency with D360 and core Salesforce platform services.

External Ecosystem Knowledge - Strong understanding of external agent ecosystems and interoperability.

Proven Track Record - Experience in prompt engineering, agent lifecycle management, and hands-on prototype development.

AI & ML Expertise - Experience with machine learning concepts (predictive and generative AI), plus the ability to communicate value to diverse audiences.

Data Stack Knowledge - Deep expertise in modern cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift) and data ingestion patterns (batch, streaming, CDC).

Hands-On Development - Proficiency in programming (e.g., JavaScript, Python, SQL, R) and data frameworks like pandas or Jupyter.

Excellent Communication - Strong presentation skills; adept at explaining complex ideas and guiding stakeholders toward impactful solutions.

Curiosity & Continuous Learning - Passion for exploring new AI frameworks, sharing insights, and experimenting with cutting-edge technologies.
 

Preferred Requirements

Advanced Integration - Experience integrating Salesforce with external agents via APIs and open standards (MCP, A2A).

Governance & Observability - Familiarity with prompt governance, observability, and monitoring frameworks.

Cross-Platform Background - Background in cross-platform integrations (e.g., Hyperscaler SDKs to Salesforce Flows).

Multimodal Pipelines - Prior exposure to conversational voice pipelines or multimodal integrations via hyperscaler services.

Advanced AI/ML Frameworks - Exposure to frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), MLOps practices, and cloud AI platforms like Google Vertex AI or AWS Sagemaker.

Education - BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or equivalent technical field.

Overview
Are you ready to help design the future of the world’s most influential financial institutions? Salesforce is looking for a Strategic Solution Engineer to join our elite team. In this role, you aren’t just selling software; you are a visionary technologist helping the largest financial institutions transition from legacy systems to Autonomous Enterprises.

From reimagining the retail banking experience with Agentforce to powering institutional wealth management with real-time Data Cloud insights, you will be the lead engineer behind the solutions that power the global economy. The SE world is a dynamic, constantly evolving environment where expertise in design, business consulting and technology is used every day to drive innovation.

The Solution Engineer must have a strong desire to demonstrate their technical and/or sales skills, including the ability to solicit business requirements, develop a technical sales strategy, configure and successfully demonstrate the solutions that address these requirements and provide business value.

Typical Day of a Financial Services Solution Engineer:

Partner with Account Executives to identify high-impact "Jobs to be Done" where Agentforce can provide 24/7 support for banking clients.

Facilitate discovery sessions focused on Data Cloud integration, showing customers how to turn "dark data" into actionable insights using the Salesforce Metadata Framework.

Build and present differentiated demonstrations that showcase Generative AI and Predictive Analytics working in tandem to increase "Wallet Share" and reduce "Churn."

Collaborate with Product and Professional Services to ensure that the vision you sell today is technically viable for the global scale of a Tier 1 bank tomorrow.

Responsibilities

A Solution Engineer plays a pivotal role in aligning innovative strategies to technology solutions within complex accounts. This role focuses on partnering with clients and collaborating with internal team members and C-level client contacts to drive consensus on multi-product technology solutions across the various Salesforce product lines.

Solutions Engineers work on a wide array of assignments including business development, operations and IT strategies, as well as executive level product demonstrations. This person must assume the role of trusted advisor for driving innovative solutions forward while also improving business performance.

Business Problem Solving: Take ambiguous and sophisticated business problems and using research and business assessment capabilities, define the problem, drive innovative ideas, define the opportunity set, and recommend practical next steps.

Innovation Management: Bring focus to a client's decision making process by communicating and evaluating solution options, and driving consensus among key collaborators. In some instances, we help our clients develop new decision frameworks and governance processes that continue to deliver value far beyond a particular engagement.

Connect Experiences: Demonstrate through software demos and rapid prototyping how connected experiences come to life with The Salesforce Solutions. This includes the delivery of executive level software demonstrations, construction of future state customer journey strategies, and developing long term IT roadmaps.

"Solutioning" is fundamental to the SE role. It is important to realize that a component of the responsibilities will include assisting the customer, Account Executive and Professional Services team with the discovery, analysis and ultimately the recommendation of strategic solutions for the customer by delivering transformational pitches based in live product demonstrations to validate. These Solutions will use all of the Salesforce technologies to address the core challenges and objectives that are uniquely identified for each customer.

Discover the customer's business needs, and position the best Salesforce solution to achieve those business objectives

Build and present customized solutions and demonstrations focused on Salesforce products to multiple customer personas showing how Salesforce will accelerate their business strategies and a path to value.

Convey a deep understanding of the customer's architecture as it pertains to Salesforce's solutions

Orchestrate and lead cross-functional solutions guides, and align them to the opportunity strategy

Develop and deliver the story of the customer experience aided by Salesforce technologies

Participate in all appropriate product, sales, and procedural training and certifications to acquire and maintain the knowledge vital to be effective in the position

Êtes-vous prêt à aider à concevoir l'avenir des institutions financières les plus influentes au monde ? Salesforce recherche un Ingénieur en Solutions Stratégiques pour rejoindre notre équipe d'élite. Dans ce rôle, vous ne vendez pas seulement des logiciels ; vous êtes un technologue visionnaire aidant les plus grandes institutions financières à passer des systèmes hérités aux Entreprises Autonomes.

De la réinvention de l'expérience bancaire de détail avec Agentforce à la gestion de patrimoine institutionnel alimentée par des insights en temps réel de Data Cloud, vous serez l'ingénieur principal derrière les solutions qui alimentent l'économie mondiale. Le monde des ingénieurs en solutions est un environnement dynamique et en constante évolution où l'expertise en design, en conseil aux entreprises et en technologie est utilisée chaque jour pour stimuler l'innovation.

L'ingénieur de solutions doit avoir un fort désir de démontrer ses compétences techniques et/ou commerciales, y compris la capacité à solliciter les exigences commerciales, à développer une stratégie de vente technique, à configurer et à démontrer avec succès les solutions qui répondent à ces exigences et apportent une valeur ajoutée à l'entreprise.

Journée typique d'un Ingénieur en Solutions pour les Services Financiers :

Collaborer avec les responsables de comptes pour identifier les "Jobs to be Done" à fort impact où Agentforce peut fournir un support 24/7 aux clients bancaires.

Faciliter des sessions de découverte axées sur l'intégration de Data Cloud, en montrant aux clients comment transformer les "données sombres" en informations exploitables en utilisant le Salesforce Metadata Framework.

Construire et présenter des démonstrations différenciées qui mettent en avant l'IA générative et l'analyse prédictive travaillant de concert pour augmenter la "part de portefeuille" et réduire le "churn".

Collaborer avec les équipes Produit et Services Professionnels pour s'assurer que la vision que vous vendez aujourd'hui est techniquement viable à l'échelle mondiale d'une banque de premier plan demain.

Responsabilités

Un ingénieur en solutions joue un rôle crucial dans l'alignement des stratégies innovantes avec les solutions technologiques au sein de comptes complexes. Ce rôle se concentre sur le partenariat avec les clients et la collaboration avec les membres de l'équipe interne et les contacts de niveau C des clients pour parvenir à un consensus sur des solutions technologiques multi-produits à travers les différentes gammes de produits Salesforce.

Les ingénieurs en solutions travaillent sur une large gamme de missions, y compris le développement commercial, les opérations et les stratégies informatiques, ainsi que les démonstrations de produits au niveau exécutif. Cette personne doit assumer le rôle de conseiller de confiance pour faire avancer des solutions innovantes tout en améliorant la performance de l'entreprise.

Résolution de problèmes commerciaux : Prendre des problèmes commerciaux ambigus et sophistiqués et, en utilisant des capacités de recherche et d'évaluation commerciale, définir le problème, générer des idées innovantes, définir l'ensemble des opportunités et recommander des étapes pratiques.

Gestion de l'innovation : Apporter de la clarté au processus de prise de décision d'un client en communiquant et en évaluant les options de solution, et en favorisant le consensus parmi les principaux collaborateurs. Dans certains cas, nous aidons nos clients à développer de nouveaux cadres décisionnels et des processus de gouvernance qui continuent à apporter de la valeur bien au-delà d'un engagement particulier.

Connecter les expériences : Démontrer à travers des démonstrations logicielles et des prototypes rapides comment les expériences connectées prennent vie avec les solutions Salesforce. Cela inclut la présentation de démonstrations logicielles de niveau exécutif, la construction de stratégies de parcours client pour l'avenir, et le développement de feuilles de route informatiques à long terme.

La "solution" est fondamentale au rôle de SE. Il est important de réaliser qu'une composante des responsabilités inclura l'assistance au client, au Responsable de Compte et à l'équipe des Services Professionnels dans la découverte, l'analyse et finalement la recommandation de solutions stratégiques pour le client en livrant des présentations transformationnelles basées sur des démonstrations de produits en direct pour valider. Ces solutions utiliseront toutes les technologies Salesforce pour répondre aux défis et objectifs principaux qui sont spécifiquement identifiés pour chaque client.

Découvrez les besoins commerciaux du client et positionnez la meilleure solution Salesforce pour atteindre ces objectifs commerciaux.

Construire et présenter des solutions personnalisées et des démonstrations axées sur les produits Salesforce à plusieurs personas clients, montrant comment Salesforce accélérera leurs stratégies commerciales et offrira une voie vers la valeur.

Transmettre une compréhension approfondie de l'architecture du client en ce qui concerne les solutions Salesforce.

Orchestrer et diriger des guides de solutions transversales, et les aligner à la stratégie d'opportunité.

Développer et livrer l'histoire de l'expérience client aidée par les technologies Salesforce.

Participer à toutes les formations et certifications appropriées sur les produits, les ventes et les procédures pour acquérir et maintenir les connaissances essentielles afin d'être efficace dans le poste.

Capacité à voyager en fonction de l'alignement du territoire et de la région.

Qualifications requises :

B.S. en Informatique, Génie Logiciel, Système d'Information de Gestion ou expérience pertinente équivalente requise. L'expérience sera évaluée en fonction des compétences clés requises pour le poste (par exemple, les rôles de leadership parascolaires, l'expérience militaire, les rôles de bénévolat, l'expérience professionnelle, etc.)

Connaissance des applications connexes, des bases de données relationnelles et des technologies web.

Solides compétences en communication orale, écrite, en présentation, en collaboration et en relations interpersonnelles.

Capacité à travailler en équipe pour résoudre des problèmes techniques dans des environnements politiques variés.

Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle.

Au moins 2 ans dans des fonctions de pré-vente en contact avec la direction.

Qualifications souhaitées :

Certifications Salesforce

Expérience préalable en tant qu'ingénieur solutions/ventes pour une entreprise de CRM ou une technologie similaire.

Role Description

The Customer Success Manager, Senior Manager is a highly strategic and experienced individual contributor responsible for driving quantifiable business impact across our most complex, often multi-org Signature customers. This role acts as a primary strategic partner who maintains a continual focus on the customer’s business goals to improve their adoption, technical health, and expertise to realize the maximum value out of their Salesforce investment. Ensuring the seamless delivery of all deliverables necessary to advance the customer’s core business goals. The Senior Manager is required to integrate multiple products or processes to create effective customer solutions.

We are looking for candidates who have experience supporting customers in one or more of the following industries:

 

Global Public Sector

Federal Civilian (FedCiv) – Work with non-defense federal agencies (such as Health & Human Services, Commerce, and Transportation) to drive digital transformation initiatives that improve citizen services, requiring knowledge of federal procurement processes and the ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance.

State & Local / Education (SL/ED) – Partner with state governments, municipalities, counties, and K-12/higher education institutions to modernize legacy systems and enhance constituent engagement, requiring understanding of diverse regulatory environments and budget cycles across jurisdictions. 

Non-Governmental Organizations (NGO) – Support mission-driven NGOs, nonprofits, and international development organizations in leveraging technology to maximize social impact and operational efficiency, requiring passion for social good and experience with grant-funded programs.

This is an Individual Contributor position.

Your Impact

Strategic Accountability and Account Leadership

ROI-Driven Engagement: Determine when and how to engage clients based on calculated ROI, ensuring all activities translate directly into tangible value for the customer.

Complex Program Management: Effectively own the Signature experience across complex, multi-org customers. This involves organizing information across multiple work streams and integrating customer priorities and timelines into comprehensive success plans.

Resource Mobilization: Act as the central resource for the team and the customer, connecting all the dots. This includes proactively taking ownership of customer needs and drawing expert resources into customer situations as needed.

Engagement Charter: Craft a clear engagement charter with specified goals and metrics to ensure alignment across internal and external teams.

Business Value Integration: Align the Account Success team and internal stakeholders around the customer’s business and technical goals, ensuring value delivery through the Signature offer.

Agentic Workflow Design: Design multi-step digital workflows where agents handle repetitive data-intensive work, freeing the CSM for high-stakes relationship building.

ROI Segmentation (Human vs. AI): Determining which customer segments or tasks require high-touch human coverage vs. “always-on” AI support.

Trusted Advisory and Executive Influence

Advanced Stakeholder Management: Cultivate and maintain relationships with customer IT and business executive leadership, demonstrating a genuine commitment to customer goals to build deep rapport.

Complex Navigation: Navigate the customer’s and Salesforce’s internal organizational dynamics to achieve results. Drive consensus with collaborators and influence key internal and external stakeholders to engage in the process.

Business Insight: Combine expert Salesforce knowledge with deep business insight to deliver effective recommendations and advance the customer’s core business goals. This includes adapting established solutions to solve complex customer problems.

Customer Advocacy: Effectively amplify the voice of the customer with internal teams to ensure the organization remains laser-focused on customer success.

Solution & Industry Expertise: Develop a strong working knowledge of Salesforce’s major solutions and a “sales pitch” understanding of the rest. Leverage industry insight to position customers for future success.

Mentorship & Development: Demonstrate a growth mindset by pursuing challenging learning activities. Mentor team members to help accelerate their personal development and contribute subject matter expertise internally within Salesforce.

Domain Expertise and Risk Mitigation

Risk Management: Act as the leader in identifying problems. Leverage the Red Accounts Escalation Play and Case Oversight & Incident Management processes when high-value renewals or Go-Live dates are at risk.

AI Governance & Guardrails: Guide customers through governance frameworks, best practices for Trust Layer, and implementation of safety-by-design principles.

Root Cause Synthesis: Can use AI tools for account-level pattern recognition and access automated RCA reports for specific scenarios.

Root Cause Analysis: Question assumptions to uncover root causes and reveal new opportunities rather than just treating symptoms.

Minimum Requirements

Experienced business professional, preferably with 5-6 years of relevant industry expertise in Customer Success, SaaS platform use, or related strategic consulting fields. 

Exceptional communication and presentation skills with a demonstrated ability to influence effectively at all levels, including executive and C-level.

Ability to handle objections, navigate complicated discussions, and drive alignment. Must demonstrate persistence in the face of adversity and disappointment.

Ability to clarify the roles and responsibilities of collaborators and serve as the central resource, ensuring clear technical and business alignment.

Cloud/Platform Requirements: 

5-6 years experience supporting customers using MuleSoft.

Experience with deep MuleSoft Anypoint Platform expertise

Strong understanding of how MuleSoft solves business problems:

API-led connectivity: Three-layer architecture enabling reusability and agility

Integration patterns: Real-time sync, batch processing, event-driven architectures

API Management: Governance, security policies, rate limiting

Deployment options: CloudHub vs Runtime Fabric - when to use each

Knowledge of MuleSoft + Salesforce integration (Salesforce Connector, Composer, Data Cloud)

Understanding of when to engage technical resources for complex integrations

Understanding of integration patterns with enterprise systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday, ServiceNow)

Familiarity with MuleSoft RPA capabilities

Multiple MuleSoft certifications (Developer + Integration Architect Associate)

Note: this role is office-flexible, and the expectation is to be in-office a minimum of three (3) days per week.

Director, Technical Architects - Data and AI

Department Description

The Data & AI Expert team is an innovative group of technical architects at the heart of Salesforce's newest innovations — Data360 and Agentforce. They don't just work with today's technology — they help customers architect for the future. This is a startup within a massive organization, focused on next-generation Data + AI + CRM + Analytics at Salesforce.
This team sits at the center of our GTM strategy, connecting the dots between Data & AI Products, Product Marketing, Enablement, Customer Success & Support, and the Partner Ecosystem. But their impact doesn't stop at the sale — this team operates across the full customer lifecycle, ensuring customers don't just buy Data360 and Agentforce, but genuinely succeed with it.

Your Impact

As a leader, your primary impact is building elite Data & AI Technical Architects and enabling them to operate at scale — across the full customer journey, from initial discovery through to realized value.

Build and lead a best-in-class team of Data and AI Technical Architects, recognized for deep expertise across data architecture, AI, Salesforce, and enterprise integration patterns.

Recruit and mentor senior-level architects with versatile communication styles. Our goal is to build a team capable of translating technical architecture into business value, whether they are whiteboarding with engineers or securing buy-in from CDOs and CIOs.

Establish clear technical standards, architectural principles, and operating rhythms that ensure consistent, high-quality execution across the territory.

Partner with Sales Leadership to define coverage and engagement models that align technical architect capacity to the highest-impact accounts and opportunities.

Serve as a technical executive sponsor for strategic customers — guiding enterprise data and AI strategy, influencing architectural decisions, and earning long-term trust that extends well beyond the close.

Champion customer outcomes across the full lifecycle — partnering with Customer Success, Support, and Professional Services to ensure technical wins translate into measurable business value. The greatest impact is realized when technical leadership remains a constant partner from the initial sale through to final delivery.

Design and scale repeatable technical evaluation motions — architectural workshops, POVs, POCs, and reference designs — that accelerate time-to-value for Data and AI initiatives.

Drive strong alignment with Product and Engineering to stay ahead of the Data & AI roadmap and represent field-driven architectural requirements.

Work closely with the Partner Ecosystem to develop offerings, use cases, and GTM strategies that extend Salesforce's Data360 reach.

Develop scalable, reusable technical enablement assets that uplift the architectural maturity of Solution Engineers, sellers, partners, and customers.

Own Salesforce's point-of-view on enterprise data and AI architecture, aligned to industry-specific needs and grounded in proven, repeatable patterns.

Bring a futurist mindset — anticipating where data, AI, and CRM technology is heading and helping customers, your team, and Salesforce think 2-3 years ahead, not just solve for today's problems.

Drive operational rigor and accountability, linking architectural excellence to ACV growth, expansion, and customer success.

Qualifications

You are a people builder and architecture leader, with a proven ability to scale deep technical talent:

10+ years leading Solution Engineering, Technical Architecture, or Technical Sales teams in Data, Analytics, and AI domains.

Demonstrated success building and scaling teams of senior architects..

BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred.

Strong full-stack technical credibility across enterprise data platforms, AI/ML concepts, and Salesforce architecture — including hands-on familiarity with Agentforce, Data360, and the Salesforce platform.

Working knowledge of agent interoperability standards (e.g., MCP, A2A) and the broader external agent ecosystem — enough to coach architects and shape Salesforce's architectural point-of-view.

Understanding of prompt engineering, agent lifecycle strategy, and applied Generative AI — able to set standards and review the work of senior architects in these areas.

Proven ability to engage and influence C-level executives — including CDOs and CIOs — while remaining grounded in hands-on architectural realities.

Data-driven leader with a history of defining and over-achieving on technical KPIs, such as architectural win rates, technical debt reduction, and time-to-value for AI deployments.

Experience driving success within large, matrixed enterprise sales organizations.

Track record of leadership recognition, customer impact, and measurable business outcomes.

Deep understanding of industry-specific data challenges, enterprise data governance (e.g., Informatica, Collibra), architectural patterns, and complex integration strategies.

Exceptional communicator and storyteller — able to translate complex Data and AI architectures into executive-level value narratives.

Familiarity with the Partner Ecosystem and experience co-developing GTM strategies with SI and ISV partners.

Technical Skill Set

This leader sets the architectural standard and is expected to remain close enough to the work to coach, review, and challenge designs:

Data Architecture & Platforms: Cloud data platforms, SQL, ingestion pipelines (batch, streaming, CDC), ETL/ELT, data modeling, semantic layers, integration patterns, and the TCO tradeoffs of building with hyperscalers vs. Salesforce. Deep familiarity with Informatica (IDMC) for enterprise data integration and MDM, alongside Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, and Redshift.

AI & Analytics: Foundational ML concepts, data preparation, Python/R, applied AI, Generative AI, prompt engineering, and agentic use cases. Agentforce & Salesforce Platform: Admin-level fluency, hands-on experience across Salesforce Clouds, and deep architectural understanding of how Data and AI are activated within Salesforce — including Agentforce, Data360, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Industry Clouds. Understanding of how external agents (Copilot, Gemini, etc.) integrate with Agentforce via open standards.

Analytics & BI: Working knowledge of tools like Tableau, PowerBI, or Looker and how they connect to enterprise data strategy.

Integration Patterns: MuleSoft APIs, hyperscaler SDKs, cross-platform integrations, and enterprise governance and compliance frameworks.

Leadership: Self-aware, strategic thinker, skilled at building relationships and developing people.

Horizon Thinker: Doesn't just respond to the market — helps shape it.

Your Impact
You will be the dedicated sales professional for strategic enterprise clients in the Netherlands. Your mission is to forge deep, strategic partnerships with leading Dutch enterprises across key industries including financial services and professional services. You will drive digital transformation by embedding Analytics solutions across their business operations, helping them unlock the power of data in everything from supply chain optimization and customer analytics to operational efficiency and strategic decision-making. Strategic Account Management: Develop and execute comprehensive account plans for designated enterprise accounts in the Netherlands, aligning Tableau and Analytics solutions with their core business objectives to meet and exceed sales quotas.

Full-Cycle Sales: Drive the entire sales cycle from opportunity identification to closure, expertly managing a complex pipeline and navigating large enterprise procurement processes.

The Team Player: You know that "winning" is a team sport. You excel at engaging internal resources and partners to close complex, multi-million dollar deals.

Pipeline & Forecasting: Meticulously manage and track all customer and transactional information in Salesforce (CRM), providing accurate and regular reporting of your pipeline and forecast.

Languages: Business proficiency in English is essential

Industry Experience: You have 8-10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with significant experience selling into the Dutch enterprise market across industries such as financial services and professional services.

Market Expertise: You possess a deep understanding of the Dutch business culture and enterprise decision-making processes, with a proven track record of successfully selling to large multinational corporations and Dutch enterprises.

Proven Performer: You have a history of consistently overachieving sales quotas and experience managing complex deals in the Netherlands region.

Solution Seller: You are an expert in value-based or solution selling of enterprise SaaS platforms (e.g., BI, data analytics, CRM, ERP).

Go-Getter: You are self-directed, resourceful, and have a strong work ethic. You are driven to build strategic relationships and maximize account revenue.

Excellent Communicator: You have outstanding presentation and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and persuasively to both technical and business audiences in Dutch and English.

Technically Savvy: You are proficient with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and other business tools. A Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience is preferred.

Salesforce is currently seeking a Sr Manager, Technical Consulting (Insurance and Financial Services) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. Our Manager, Technical Consulting role plays a meaningful part in managing, training, and building the careers of our technical consulting team. We are key players in this objective, as they can use Industry Cloud functionality to deliver customer requirements quickly with minimal customization. 

In addition to people leadership, career coaching, and project oversight responsibilities for the team, you will build our Financial Services practice through leading internal initiatives, contributing to the technical practice business plan, developing methodology, creating team enablement, onboarding new architects, and recruiting to build the team.

Responsibilities:

You’ll have up to 35 reports under your scope of responsibility. You will be required to deliver technical work (as a senior technical architect) on Financial Services domain projects at 25% utilization and balance that with leading your team of Technical Consultants, Architects and Managers.

You’ll be responsible for hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Consultants on Financial Services so they can implement successfully in turning the program design of our Solution Architects and Technical Architects into highest-quality solutions that meets the customers’ needs.

Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies that drive increased business value

Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs

Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.

Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our FSC clients leveraging Salesforce Financial Services Cloud, Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, and Experience Cloud

Ensure the success of these teams while securing the highest CSAT and business outcomes

Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party stakeholders

Establish trust with the customer’s leadership, promoting and/or implementing best practices with SFI and Salesforce

16+ years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling individual contributors.

The Strategic Partner Recruitment Manager is a highly specialized, crucial role responsible for identifying, targeting, recruiting, and onboarding net-new System Integrator (SI) partners across the ASEAN market.

We are seeking an exceptional Global Migration Factory Leader to join our Global Migration Services team. This critical role combines strategic migration expertise with hands-on technical leadership to drive successful migrations across Marketing Next, Tableau Next, and Revenue Cloud while building scalable frameworks and reusable assets for scaled field deployment by our professional services team and partners.

Background

Salesforce is at a pivotal moment across multiple product portfolios. The shift from legacy solutions to next-generation platforms — Marketing Next, Tableau Next, and Revenue Cloud — represents one of the most significant product transition efforts in the company's history, and one of the greatest opportunities to deepen customer trust at scale.

To meet this moment, Salesforce has established a Global Migration Factory: a dedicated, high-velocity engineering organization purpose-built to move customers to next-generation platforms with speed, consistency, and confidence. This is not a traditional implementation practice. It operates at the intersection of product, engineering, and customer success — developing and refining the repeatable frameworks, playbooks, and tooling that make migration scalable. Critically, insights from the factory floor feed directly back into the products themselves, driving the development of native migration capabilities that reduce friction for every customer that follows.

Business Objectives

The Migration Factory exists to accelerate customer transitions to Marketing Next, Tableau Next, and Revenue Cloud, de-risk the migration experience for customers and Salesforce alike, and continuously improve the systems that make migration faster and more predictable over time. Every engagement sharpens the playbook. Every technical challenge is an opportunity to build a better tool — whether that lives in the Migration Factory's toolkit or inside the products themselves. This is field R&D in the truest sense.

Expected Outcomes and Customer Benefits

For customers, the Migration Factory transforms migration from a bespoke, high-risk project into a structured, proven path to next-generation platforms. Timelines compress. Risk decreases. And customers arrive on their new platform positioned to take full advantage of its capabilities — not just survive the transition. Because the factory is integrated with Salesforce's Forward Deployed Engineering organization, customer feedback flows directly to product teams, accelerating resolution and ensuring the customer's voice shapes what gets built next.

In this role, you will:

Leadership & Team Management

Lead a High-Performing Migration Team: Recruit, mentor, and develop migration leaders and teams across Marketing Next, Tableau Next, and Revenue Cloud. You'll be responsible for staffing, capacity planning, and ensuring the team has the resources needed for successful migration delivery.

Ensure Operational Excellence: Monitor key performance indicators including migration velocity, asset reusability, and customer satisfaction. Coach your team on improvement areas and effectively manage complex migration escalations.

Diversity & Equality: You'll create a diverse, inclusive and psychologically safe environment for your team.

Technical Strategy & Execution

Maintain Technical Authority: Serve as the ultimate technical escalation point for migrations across Marketing Next, Tableau Next, and Revenue Cloud, staying current on platform capabilities as these solutions mature and are fully released during FY27. Working with Product & Engineering teams you will maintain deep expertise in version differences, deprecation schedules, and migration pathways.

Build Migration Frameworks: Develop standardized migration methodologies, assessment tools, and playbooks that can be scaled across the field organization. Create reusable technical assets including migration agents, scripts, data transformation utilities, configuration templates, and validation frameworks.

Guide Complex Migrations: Lead your team in assessing customer migration readiness, identifying compatibility barriers, mapping legacy functionality to new capabilities, and developing phased migration strategies. Directly assist with the most complex technical challenges across all product lines.

Influence Product: Partner with Product and Engineering teams across Marketing Next, Tableau Next, and Revenue Cloud on migration tooling requirements, sharing field insights to inform automated migration capabilities and version transition features.

Customer & Business Impact

Drive Migration Success: Build and maintain strong executive relationships within a defined customer portfolio, ensuring successful version migrations with minimal business disruption and maximum feature adoption.

Manage Portfolio Performance: Operationally manage your migration portfolio, monitoring key metrics including migration timelines, technical debt reduction, and post-migration health scores to accelerate progress toward completion goals.

Strategic Alignment: Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Professional Services teams to ensure customers migrate successfully while capturing lessons learned and feeding insights back into framework development.

We're looking for someone with:

Proven Leadership: 5+ years in direct people management or indirect leadership roles, with a track record in talent management and technical team building.

Deep Product Migration Expertise: Extensive hands-on experience leading customer migrations for one or more of Marketing Next, Tableau Next, or Revenue Cloud. Strong understanding of version differences, deprecated features, and migration complexities.

Migration Architecture Skills: Proven experience leading complex system migrations or platform upgrades, with ability to architect phased migration strategies that minimize risk and business impact.

Framework Development Mindset: Track record of creating reusable technical assets, standardized methodologies, or scalable tooling that has been successfully adopted by broader teams.

Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background in high-touch customer success strategies at the enterprise level, coupled with executive-level communication and influence skills.

Problem-Solving Mindset: Resourcefulness, flexibility, and a "get-it-done" demeanor are essential when navigating migration complexities.

Preferred Qualifications:

8+ years extensive hands-on experience with migration APIs, SQL queries, and data architecture.

5+ years experience migrating customers across one or more of Marketing Cloud, Tableau, or Revenue Cloud platforms.

Experience with Marketing Cloud migrations including journey builder, automation studio, email studio, data extensions, and API integrations.

Experience with Tableau migrations including server-to-cloud transitions, workbook migrations, REST API automation, or embedded analytics.

Experience with Revenue Cloud migrations including CPQ upgrades, Billing transitions, or quote-to-cash platform migrations.

Familiarity with data migration tooling, ETL processes, and data quality frameworks.

Relevant Salesforce certifications (Marketing Cloud Administrator, Marketing Cloud Consultant, Tableau certifications, CPQ Specialist, Revenue Cloud Consultant, or platform certifications).

Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the Values & Behaviors for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

Overview of the Role

Salesforce is seeking a Senior Director of Monetization Strategy that will be responsible for developing long term monetization for Salesforce’s flexible pricing model. This individual will work closely with the product development organization to understand the product roadmap and will define the future packaging/pricing in order to target specific customer segments. Additionally, this person will evaluate, design, and test new commercial models that align to evolving market trends and customer needs, and accelerate Salesforce’s growth.

The candidate must be comfortable with creating clarity out of ambiguity, leveraging a hypothesis-driven problem solving toolkit, supporting executive decisioning on complex decisions with lots of conflicting priorities, analyzing large amounts of product data, conducting quantitative and qualitative market and competitive research, and helping influence and shape product and business strategy. 

Responsibilities

Partner with product leadership to identify and prioritize products & features for pricing and packaging

Collaborate with leaders in our product, marketing, finance organizations to help craft new commercial models, define strategies for new offerings, optimize packaging & pricing for existing offers, and drive overall monetization

Utilize multi-point market inputs to design revenue maximizing strategies

Design & lead qualitative and quantitative sales and customer research to test pricing & packaging strategy hypotheses

Design analysis to draw conclusions from product and feature usage patterns

Conduct market research on competitors in similar and adjacent markets

Develop and effectively communicate recommendations; influence senior executives and gain alignment on pricing

Maintain and nurture executive level relationships at Salesforce

May require leading a team of pricing strategists

Required Skills/Qualifications

8+ years of relevant experience (specific level will be determined based on overall experience, expertise, and performance in the interview process)

Proven ability to frame ambiguous / complex problems, facilitate executive decision making amongst conflicting priorities

Strong problem solving, analytical and time management skills: Develop hypotheses, define strategic framework; Gather and analyze data, develop insights and recommendations for executives

Collaborate with multiple executive stakeholders to align on strategic path forward 

Operationalize strategy; ongoing prioritization as new information comes to light

Drive cross functional execution to get things done

Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to communicate effectively with and influence the decisions of different levels of management

Intellectually curious, creative strategic business thinker who loves to tackle complex challenges

Experience managing and running concurrent projects with complex stakeholder dynamics

Proven track record of working and excelling in high pressure environments

Demonstrated ability to drive own work with minimal supervision

Proficiency with MS Excel and experience with large data sets and supporting tools/languages, e.g., SQL, Business Objects, Tableau, R, Python

Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be
evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

For candidates outside of San Francisco, expected travel to San Francisco up to ~20% per year

Preferred Skills/Qualifications

4+ years of SaaS pricing or strategy experience

4+ years of experience in software technology company

Familiarity with developer-focused software products and their business models

Prior management consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy, monetization /product strategy or product management experience

MBA preferred

The Global Brand & Creative team within Marketing is responsible for our brand and marketing creative. From building brand awareness campaigns to designing experiences like Dreamforce, our multi-faceted team does it all. We are a collection of thinkers, makers and doers, whose sole purpose is to bring the brand to life across our incredible portfolio of work. Within this team, the Experiential Creative function is responsible for how Salesforce shows up in physical spaces, from flagship events and trade shows to brand partnerships and activations.

About the role

Salesforce is looking for an exceptional Associate Creative Director, Experiential to join our growing internal agency and help shape how the brand comes to life in physical spaces. Reporting into the Senior Creative Director, you will concept, design, and deliver brand experiences end to end from strategy and ideation through production and on-site execution across events, activations, trade shows, and brand partnerships.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll be as comfortable building the deck and directing an install as you are pitching the vision to stakeholders. You should bring a genuine point of view on experiential design and a belief that brand experiences should be meaningful, not just functional. The right person will push beyond industry convention while staying true to the Salesforce brand, always advocating for craft, consistency, and creative ambition.

What you'll do

Own experiential creative projects end to end from initial concept through design development, production, and on-site delivery across events, activations, and trade show programs

Work closely with the Creative Director(s) and cross-functional teams to develop experiential concepts that align with marketing briefs and business objectives

Develop creative ideas and spatial design concepts that meet project KPIs; test and iterate when necessary

Establish and maintain creative standards, design principles, and frameworks for experiential work that extend the brand into physical environments

Bring a design-led approach to every project ensuring experiential work is rooted in strong visual and spatial design thinking, not just logistics and production

Concept and deliver interactive product storytelling moments within experiences finding compelling, tangible ways to put Salesforce products in attendees' hands

Partner with agencies, vendors, and production partners to scale experiential programs while maintaining creative quality and brand integrity

Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, strategic events, and creative leadership to present concepts and align experiential work with broader brand and campaign strategies

Develop relationships with partner brands and collaborators that create elevated, co-branded experiences

Mentor designers and creative team members, setting a high bar for craft and creative thinking

Stay deeply informed on experiential design trends, emerging technology, and AI bringing insights that push our work and processes forward

What experience you have

BA or BFA in Design, Architecture, Spatial Design, or related field

10+ years of experience in experiential creative with a portfolio that demonstrates brand activations, event design, trade shows, and/or brand partnerships

3+ years of experience leading and mentoring creative teams in an agency or in-house creative group

Proven ability to take experiential projects from concept through production and on-site execution

Strong spatial design sensibility with hands-on expertise across environmental graphics, stage design, booth design, and installation work

A design-led portfolio that demonstrates strong visual and spatial thinking, not just event production

Experience creating interactive product demonstrations or storytelling moments within experiential environments translating complex technology into engaging, hands-on experiences

Outstanding presentation skills and a proven ability to pitch creative visions to senior stakeholders

Experience partnering with agencies, fabricators, and production vendors to deliver at scale

Working knowledge of AI and emerging technology, with the ability to conceptualize experiences that authentically represent products and innovation; B2B / tech experience is a plus

Expert knowledge of creative tools including Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and familiarity with 3D/rendering tools (SketchUp, Cinema 4D, or similar)

You are excited about this role because:

You believe brand experiences should be crafted, not templated

You love building whether that's a function, a stage, or an idea from scratch

You're as energized by the install day as you are by the concept phase

You never shy from a challenge

We are excited about you because:

You bring a genuine point of view and elevated sense of craft to every experience you touch

You find creative ways to make complex products tangible and interactive in physical spaces.

You push beyond trade show convention while staying grounded in brand and strategy

You're always bringing new references, materials, and ideas to the table from architecture to retail to installation art

You inspire the people around you and raise the bar for what experiential work can be
